title: Product Manager Hardware
description:
About the role

You will own a physical product line end to end, from the first customer insight to units shipping off the line and the experience after purchase. You sit at the centre of industrial design, mechanical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, and go-to-market teams, and you decide what gets built, why, and when.

**Experience:**
 4–8 years

What you'll do

**Strategy and discovery**

* Talk to customers, retailers, and service teams to find the problems worth solving; turn them into a clear product vision and multi-year roadmap.
* Size markets, study competitors, and build business cases covering target price, bill of materials (BOM) cost, margin, and volume.

**Definition**

* Write product requirement documents (PRDs) that set features, performance specs, certifications, and cost targets.
* Make the trade-offs between cost, quality, features, and schedule, and document why.

**Development and launch**

* Drive the product through the build gates (EVT, DVT, PVT) to mass production with engineering and contract manufacturers.
* Work with sourcing on component selection, supplier risk, and lead times; keep BOM cost on target.
* Define test plans and quality gates with QA, and own the decision to ship.
* Plan launches with marketing, sales, and service: positioning, pricing, packaging, channel readiness, and spares.

**After launch**

* Track returns, field failures, reviews, and service tickets; turn them into fixes, firmware updates, and next-generation requirements.
* If the product is connected, own the companion app and firmware roadmap alongside the hardware.

What we're looking for

* 4+ years in product management, with at least 2 years on physical products.
* Shipped at least one hardware product from concept to mass production.
* Working knowledge of the hardware lifecycle: build gates, DFM, BOM costing, tooling, and certification (BIS, CE, FCC, or similar).
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers, including in-factory visits.
* Comfortable with numbers: unit economics, pricing, forecasting, and P&L impact.
* Clear writer and communicator who can align engineers, executives, and partners.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, industrial design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

* Background as a hardware, mechanical, or electrical engineer before moving into product.
* Experience with connected (IoT) devices, embedded firmware, and companion mobile apps.
* Consumer electronics or home appliance experience, including retail and e-commerce channels.
* Exposure to manufacturing in India, China, or Southeast Asia.
* Familiarity with sustainability requirements: repairability, materials, and e-waste rules.

How success is measured

**First 90 days**

* Learn the current products, customers, and supplier base; visit the factory floor.
* Audit the roadmap and BOM costs, and bring a prioritised set of improvements.
* Own at least one in-flight program through its next build gate.

**Ongoing**

* Launches hit their planned date, cost, and quality targets.
* Product margin and BOM cost stay on plan.
* Return rate and field failure rate fall generation over generation.
* Customer ratings and NPS rise for the products you own.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

title: Transformation Leader-Master Black Belt
description:
The Transformation Leader (Insurance) is responsible for driving end-to-end operational transformation across Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier & broker operations. The role focuses on improving efficiency, scalability, service quality, and profitability through process redesign, digitization, operating model changes, and data-driven decision making.

The role would be responsible for the effective delivery of the Transformation Roadmaps and projects for the clients with a distinctive focus on deploying digital technologies like Robotics, Machine Learning, Intelligent automations, Generative AI, etc. by working with cross-functional global teams to favourably impact to the business outcomes of the customer.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Operational Transformation**

• Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across core broker operations, including:

• Policy placement & renewals

• Endorsements & mid-term adjustments

• New business onboarding

• Claims coordination & servicing

• Carrier interactions and compliance

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cost drivers; redesign processes using Lean / Six Sigma principles.

• Standardize workflows across lines of business, geographies, and acquired broker entities.

**2. Digital & Automation Enablement**

• Drive adoption of digital tools, workflow platforms, and automation (RPA, OCR, straight-through processing).

• Partner with IT, vendors, and Insurtech to modernize broker management systems (BMS), CRM, and document management.

• Enable data integration between carriers, brokers, and internal systems.

**3. Operating Model & Organization Design**

• Define target operating models aligned to growth, M&A, and client segmentation strategies.

• Optimize role clarity, spans of control, and sourcing models (onshore/offshore/shared services).

• Support post-merger integration for acquired brokerages.

**4. Performance & Analytics**

• Establish operational KPIs and dashboards (e.g., turnaround time, hit ratios, cost per policy, error rates).

• Embed performance management routines and continuous improvement culture.

• Use data to drive prioritization of transformation initiatives.

**5. Change & Stakeholder Management**

• Lead change management across frontline teams, leaders, and partners.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Communicate vision, progress, and impact clearly and consistently.

**Skillset**

* 12–18+ years of experience in insurance, with deep exposure to P&C broker or carrier operations
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation or operational excellence programs
* Strong understanding of broker workflows, carrier interactions, and regulatory requirements
* Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams
* Experience in setting up process measurement systems with advance visualization tools to implement real time monitoring frameworks and platforms
* Proficiency in data and analytical tools like control charts, descriptive statistics, box charts, hypothesis testing etc
* Certifications in Project Management, Automation, Design Thinking will be preferred.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and risk-taking abilities.
* Strong Quantitative and problem-solving ability: Ability to conceptualize complex problems and develop an Analytical Road map for them
* Experience of leading and driving strategic initiatives for COO, CFO and CIO personas
* Proven experience in driving continuous improvements across teams using Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Digital and Automation Solutions, Advanced Analytics and GenAI
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management with ability to work in diverse teams and with multiple stakeholders

title: Tax Technology Services Consultant II-SAP PaPM
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP PaPM - Tax Technology Services Consultant II**
Join Deloitte’s Tax Management Consulting team and support global clients as they modernize tax operations through SAP-enabled transformation. As an SAP PaPM -Tax Technology Services Consultant II, you will help translate tax and business requirements into scalable technology solutions that support complex business change. This role offers the opportunity to work across large transformation programs, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to the design and delivery of tax technology solutions within SAP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an SAP PaPM -Tax Technology Services Consultant II on the Tax Management Consulting team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Evaluating client tax and business requirements to define SAP PaPM and broader tax technology solution designs
* Translating functional requirements into system design specifications and supporting configuration, build, testing, and deployment activities
* Assessing current-state processes, supply chains, and systems landscapes to identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Coordinating with client stakeholders, internal teams, and systems integration partners to communicate status, resolve issues, and support project delivery
* Contributing to demos, solution assets, and internal accelerators that support Deloitte’s S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition

**The team**
Tax Management Consulting brings together consulting, technology, tax, and tax reporting experience to help organizations address multi-jurisdictional tax operations, compliance, reporting, tax technology, and tax risk management. Within this practice, the S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition supports SAP-enabled business transformation by helping clients design and implement tax solutions that align with broader enterprise processes. Professionals on this team work across complex transformation programs with Deloitte practitioners and client stakeholders to deliver practical, scalable tax technology solutions.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore / Gurgaon / Mumbai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
Regular business hours
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Taxation; or MBA; or Chartered Accountant qualification
* 3-7 years of experience in SAP or SAP S/4HANA
* Experience implementing SAP PaPM in project environments
* Experience with SAP HANA, SQL Script, SAP BW, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP HANA Studio
* Experience working with project delivery methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall
* Experience supporting SAP migration and testing processes
* Experience preparing client demos and presentation materials for stakeholder audiences

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
* Experience integrating SAP with other modules
* Knowledge of tax touchpoints within SAP and SAP S/4HANA
* Experience with tax procedures, tax conditions, general ledger setup, tax codes, access sequences, condition records, and intercompany tax configuration

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the Function**

The Product Management function at MakeMyTrip sits at the core of how we build, scale, and reimagine travel. By bringing together technology, data, design, and business insight, it creates seamless experiences for millions of travelers across discovery, personalization, payments, and loyalty.

Our PM teams act as mini-CEOs — shaping strategy, translating insights into impact, and pushing the boundaries of travel tech to make MMT a truly product-first organization.

Within this, myBiz — MakeMyTrip's comprehensive business travel suite — is redefining how organizations manage corporate travel end to end. The Post Sales charter focuses on everything that happens after a booking is made: servicing, support, modifications, and issue resolution, ensuring corporate travelers and travel admins get a fast, reliable, and delightful experience at every step.

**About the Role**

The Product Manager role for myBiz Post Sales is centered around building high-impact, AI-led solutions that transform how corporate travelers are serviced after booking. The incumbent will own the Voice Bot and conversational AI experience within the post-sales journey — driving automation, deflection, and quality across customer interactions.

A core focus of this role is leveraging AI to power the Voice Bot, systematically measuring and improving its quality through evaluation frameworks (Evals) and customer frustration scoring, and continuously expanding the range of use cases the bot can resolve autonomously. A key success metric is measuring actual agent handoff and consistently reducing it through smarter, higher-quality automation.

This role demands a strong product mindset, comfort with AI/ML-driven products and data, and close collaboration with business, tech, design, and analytics teams. The Product Manager will be expected to deeply understand post-sales pain points, prioritize impactful initiatives, and deliver outcomes that improve customer experience and operational efficiency for myBiz.

**What will you be doing**

* Owning the AI-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the myBiz post-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate, scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously.
* Defining and driving the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-led servicing to deliver measurable improvements in automation, deflection, and customer satisfaction.
* Building and operationalizing Evals (evaluation frameworks) to measure Voice Bot quality, accuracy, and reliability, and driving consistent quality improvements based on these signals.
* Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses.
* Measuring actual agent handoff rates and driving initiatives to systematically reduce handoffs through higher-quality automation and expanded coverage.
* Continuously identifying and adding new post-sales use cases for the Voice Bot to handle, expanding automation coverage while maintaining quality.
* Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases.
* Owning and tracking key product KPIs, analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post-launch to strengthen adoption and experience.
* Building strong product insights through consistent customer engagement, conversation analysis, market research, and competitive benchmarking.
* Creating a seamless and differentiated service experience for corporate travelers and travel admins within the myBiz ecosystem.
* Demonstrating a passion for data, problem-solving and simplifying complex experiences to deliver intuitive, high impact solutions.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 1-3 years of experience in a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business or product environment.
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, conversational AI, or automation is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

**Key Success Factors for the Role**

* Customer Centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving customer and partner experiences.
* Ownership & Execution: Ability to translate ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strategic Thinking: Aptitude for building long-term product vision aligned with business goals.
* Analytical Rigor: Data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making, especially around Evals, quality metrics, and handoff reduction.
* Innovation & Agility: Eagerness to experiment with AI, learn quickly, and adapt solutions to dynamic market needs.
* Communication & Influence: Strong ability to articulate product vision and rally teams around shared outcomes.

Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**
  NFX Digital is a data-driven digital marketing company transforming the consumer and marketing research landscape in India. Through its flagship platform Adytude.com, NFX Digital blends traditional research instruments with innovative, digital-first methodologies to deliver fast, cost-effective, and statistically robust insights

**About the Role**

* **Experience:**

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

  Full-time, Work from Office

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.

If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.

**What you'll own**

* **Category strategy & P&L.**
  Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.
* **Range & assortment architecture.**
  Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.
* **Buying & merchandise planning.**
  Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.
* **Pricing & margin.**
  Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.
* **Product lifecycle & launches.**
  Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.
* **Cross-functional partnership.**
  Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.
* **Data-led decisions.**
  Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.
* **Team leadership.**
  Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.

**What you bring**

* Deep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.
* The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.
* Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.
* A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.
* The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.
* 10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.
* Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.
* Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience.

**Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems.**

**Experience:**
Proven engineering leadership experience required

**Preferred background:**
Strong product-based technology companies

**Role:**
Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

**Expectation:**
High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both:
**build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems.**

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively.

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production.

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself.

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built.

**We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves.**

**What You Will Own**

1. Engineering execution and delivery

* Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems.
* Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays.
* Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations.
* Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability.
* Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps.
* Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention.

2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

* Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership.
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required.
* Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market.
* Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard.

3. Team leadership and people management

* Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership.
* Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution.
* Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly.
* Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service.
* Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve.
* Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager.
* Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary.

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT.

* Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
* Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification.
* Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software.
* Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security.
* Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost.
* Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes.
* Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection.

**We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own.**

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges.

Depending on the problem, this may involve:

* Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems.
* Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management.
* Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency.
* AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation.
* Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints.

6. Business ownership

* Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap.
* Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem.
* Make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems.
* Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders.

You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value.

The Non-Negotiable Bar

**Technical credibility:**
You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture.

**Independent execution:**
You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team.

**Leadership without hiding behind delegation:**
You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution.

**Breadth of experience:**
You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization.

**AI-native thinking:**
You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity.

**Accountability:**
When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence.

**People leadership:**
You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly.

What We Do Not Want

* A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code.
* A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates.
* An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details.
* A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem.
* A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

* The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution.
* Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership.
* Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity.
* Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically.
* AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput.
* Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems.
* You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck.

Interview Process

* **Technical deep dive:**
  Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated.
* **Live problem solving:**
  Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem.
* **System design:**
  Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed.
* **AI-agent exercise:**
  Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work.
* **Engineering management scenarios:**
  Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks.
* **Execution review:**
  Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result.
* **Ownership verification:**
  Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered.

We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers.

**The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.**

title: Knowledge Analyst - Product Development
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will spend a significant part (~70% to 80%) of your time working onsite as part of consulting teams helping solve complex client problems in product development domain.
  
  
Your work majorly includes (and is not limited to) helping client teams estimate product cost based on clean sheet costing (and hence design a low cost product), rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights, working on new product development arena reducing new product development time, cost and quality attributes, carrying on survey to understand improvement aspects of the organization to support an efficient and effective product development and improving thereof to build a sustainable capability for the R&D organization for clients, etc.
  
  
The remaining time (~20% to 30%) will be spent on developing cutting-edge knowledge related to the Product Development (PD) domain and in delivering specialized remote services to clients.
  
  
You will focus on product development & design across industries. You will be expected to work on various product development engagements, provide expert client service by way of clean sheet costing, cost saving ideas/lever identification, and product teardown analysis.
  
  
You will also be required to support development and maintenance of various practice knowledge initiatives (build firm’s knowledge on product development related topics). This is a global role (cross geography, cross industry) and would work well for those who truly envision themselves growing into ‘experts’ within the PD domain.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Engineering degree (Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Production, Electronics). In addition to an Engineering degree, an MBA from a school with a specialization in Operations will be an added advantage
* 1+ years of experience in should costing of parts or systems under procurement / R&D functions at OEM or Tier 1 (systems suppliers); prior experience in a multi-national environment is desirable
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate complex cost structures, identify root causes and drivers, and propose optimization solutions
* Proven experience building or using bottom-up cost models; familiarity with research-based modeling (e.g., process parameters, cycle times, material utilization, yields) is highly valued
* Proficient in reading engineering drawings and technical specifications
* Knowledge of the manufacturing process of various categories (OEM/Tier1/Tier 2)
* Excellent problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions
* Flexibility, patience and understanding of fluid, demanding, and unstructured environments, where priorities evolve constantly, and methodologies are regularly challenged
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, interact effectively with members from all levels in McKinsey and client organizations, with strong communication skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in both written and spoken English

title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – Travel Fintech
description:
QuadLabs Technologies builds travel technology for airlines, TMCs and corporates — booking engines, B2B/B2E corporate travel platforms, and AI-native Travel & Expense products. We are hiring a Product Manager who has already built travel products, not someone who has operated them.

You will own a product area end to end: discovery, PRDs, roadmap, delivery with engineering, and adoption with client teams. You will work directly with airline and TMC clients, so you must be able to talk GDS, NDC, fares and policy with confidence from day one.

Location: Gurugram / Delhi NCR

Experience: 4–10 years total, with at least 3 years as a PM in Travel Tech

Reports to: Head of Product

Type: Full-time

Who we're looking for

This role is open only to product managers whose PM experience comes from one of three backgrounds:

•      
**Travel tech product companies**
— booking engines, GDS/NDC aggregators, airline IT, hotel

distribution, corporate booking tools, T&E platforms

•      
**OTAs**
— B2C or B2B online travel agencies

•      
**TMCs**
— in the TMC's product or technology team, building its booking platform, self-booking tool, or

client-facing tech

The experience must be in a
**product management role**
(owning roadmap, writing PRDs, shipping with engineering).
**Travel operations, ticketing, fulfilment, reservations, customer support, or account management experience does not count toward the 3 years, even at the companies above.**

Key responsibilities

1.     Own the roadmap for a product area (e.g. air booking, hotel, corporate policy & approvals, expense,

payments) and tie it to client and revenue outcomes.

2.     Run discovery with airline, TMC and corporate stakeholders; turn it into clear PRDs, user stories and

acceptance criteria.

3.     Design booking and servicing flows: search, pricing, fare rules, ancillaries, seat/meal, PNR creation,

ticketing, exchanges, refunds and cancellations.

4.     Define integration requirements for GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), NDC airline APIs, LCC

connectors, hotel aggregators and payment gateways.

5.     Build corporate travel features: travel policy, approval workflows, budgets, cost centres, duty of care,

reporting and HRMS/ERP integrations.

6.     Work daily with engineering, design and QA through sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT and

release.

7.     Set and track product KPIs — search-to-book conversion, look-to-book ratio, online adoption,

booking failure rate, NPS.

8.     Support pre-sales and client delivery with demos, solution documents and scope sign-offs.

9.     Track the market — NDC adoption, competitor OTAs and TMC platforms, AI in travel — and bring it

into the roadmap.

Must-have

•      3+ years as a Product Manager at a travel tech company, OTA or TMC (see above)

•      Shipped at least one travel product or major module to live customers, and can walk through it in

detail

•      Working knowledge of air distribution: GDS vs NDC vs LCC content, PNR lifecycle, fare families, fare

rules, ticketing and reissue

•      Understanding of at least one of: hotel distribution, corporate travel (policy, approvals, SBT), or travel

expense

•      Can read API documentation and discuss request/response flows with engineers (Swagger/Postman

level)

•      Strong PRD writing, user flows and wireframing (Figma or similar)

•      Comfortable with Jira/Confluence and agile delivery

•      Clear written and spoken English; able to present to client leadership

Nice to have

•      B2B / corporate travel experience (self-booking tools, TMC platforms, CUG portals)

•      Experience with airline clients or airline-direct channels

•      Middle East (GCC) or Indian corporate travel market exposure

•      AI/LLM product features shipped (chat booking, smart search, receipt OCR, policy agents)

•      Payments in travel: corporate cards, virtual cards, BSP/ARC settlement, wallets

•      SQL or analytics tools for funnel analysis

Not a fit

Please do not apply if your background is mainly any of the following:

•      Travel operations, ticketing, reservations, fulfilment or back office

•      Customer support, service desk or implementation/onboarding support

•      Account management, travel desk or client servicing at a TMC

•      Sales or pre-sales without product ownership

•      Product roles outside travel (e-commerce, fintech, SaaS) with no travel product experience

•      Business analyst or project manager roles with no roadmap or PRD ownership

**Interested candidates can share their resume at hr@quadlabs.com or apply through LinkedIn.**

title: Business Product Manager – Agentic AI
description:

We're hiring a Business Product Manager to lead FlixStock's Self-Learning AI Platform — an agentic AI system that combines Generative AI and fashion/creative domain expertise to produce high-quality creative output at scale.

You will be the business and product owner for the platform, responsible for customer outcomes, product quality, business roadmap, scalability and the commercial metrics that drive product performance. The question that defines this role: is the product materially better every week for customers, users and the business?

**What You Will Own :**

* Strong analytical and systems-thinking ability, with comfort working with data, metrics and experimentation.
* Proven ability to translate customer problems into structured product requirements.
* Ability to prioritise between customer requirements, business impact and product scalability.

Experience with AI-powered products or fashion/ecommerce/creative technology.

* Measurable improvement in product quality and customer outcomes.
* Lower cost and improved operational efficiency.
* Faster turnaround and resolution of recurring product problems.
* Increasing customer adoption and scalability.
* A product that becomes increasingly repeatable, scalable and commercially sustainable across customers.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:

With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Lead, Business Systems Analyst on the Financial Risk Technology (Summit/Calypso) team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer (Financial Risk Technology) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to drive quality assurance (QA) testing. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business requirements, creating project and process specifications, and coordinating with project teams. You will ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget while helping solve complex business problems and deliver innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our customers!
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Support the Lead, Software Engineer setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team; begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others with occasional guidance
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Work on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data; exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production
* Ensure alignment of product features and stories (i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision)
* Understand the vision and own aspects of product management / roadmap activities
* Use programming languages including but not limited to SQL, Oracle SQL, Test Management Tools, Agile, SDLC, Git and GitHub, Jira (Basics), and Microsoft Tools

**The Skills And Expertise You Will Bring**

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields
* 5-7 years of experience in Calypso Application testing in critical modules including Collateral, Pricing Difference, UFT, VBScript, and API testing (SOAP & REST); experience in Functional and Regression testing with hands-on experience in the QFrame automation framework
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:
* Project/Product Management: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle
* Effective Communication: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team
* Decision-Making & Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment
* Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations
* Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role
* Financial Acumen: Knowledge of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast)
* Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.
