title: Senior Manager, AI Strategy and Platforms
description:
Suntory Global Spirits is a world leader in premium spirits with beloved iconic brands, rooted in more than 200 years of heritage and craftsmanship. Our values are deep-rooted, and we aspire to live our purpose to ‘Inspire the Brilliance of Life’ in everything we do. Our ambition is to become the World’s Most Admired Premium Spirits Company. We want to be Most Admired not only for our incredible brands, but also for the brilliant experiences we foster, the ways in which we bring people together, the impactful marketing and innovation we deliver, and for the positive impact we have on the world around us. When you’re on our team, you can build a career of personal and professional growth across functions, business units and geographies. At Suntory Global Spirits, our employees work together to Unleash Their Spirit and realize their full potential each and every day.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Mission of Role**
The Senior Manager, AI Strategy and Platforms leads the development and execution of the AI strategy, platform and adoption agenda. The role translates business priorities into a coherent AI roadmap and practical operating processes; helps ensure approved AI platforms are trusted, usable and well governed; and enables colleagues to adopt AI responsibly at scale.
  
  
**Strategy, roadmap and demand portfolio**
Develop and maintain the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap, aligned to business priorities, Digital Products strategy and platform capabilities; provide recommendations on priorities and trade-offs to senior leadership.
  
  
Manage a prioritized AI demand portfolio, with clear problem statements, expected value, readiness criteria and recommended route to delivery.
  
  
Manage the AI Factory’s functional processes, including demand intake and qualification, prioritisation criteria, business-readiness requirements, functional acceptance, adoption measures and value-realisation process.
  
  
Create an approved, prioritised functional brief for each Factory engagement, covering the business problem, target users, expected value, process owner, governance route, business constraints, success measures and adoption plan.
  
  
Prepare investment logic and business cases for AI platforms, capabilities and priority use cases; support funding, budget-planning, cost stewardship and vendor decisions in partnership with Finance and Procurement.
  
  
Track strategic outcomes, adoption and value realisation, using evidence to adapt priorities and roadmap decisions.
  
  
**AI Platforms And Service Experience**
Develop platform-roadmap recommendations for enterprise AI platforms, model providers and supporting services, balancing business value, user experience, scalability, risk and cost.
  
  
Manage the platform-service model, including target users, service catalogue, onboarding paths, roles and permissions, support model, lifecycle standards and platform runbooks.
  
  
Monitor the AI platform as a business service, including user experience, adoption signals, access and support experience, provider performance, commercial fit and vendor roadmaps; lead business-side escalations and prioritisation.
  
  
Translate approved platform priorities into clear, actionable business requirements for Architecture and vendor partners.
  
  
Maintain a clear, scalable approach to platform onboarding, access, usage standards and lifecycle management.
  
  
**Governance and demand management**
Implement and operate the AI governance model, including policies, decision rights, intake criteria, approval pathways and governance forums.
  
  
Ensure AI demand is assessed consistently for strategic fit, business value, data readiness, security, privacy, model risk and adoption readiness.
  
  
Coordinate governance decisions and escalations with Security, Legal, Privacy, Architecture and business stakeholders; ensure decisions, risks and accountabilities are visible and actioned.
  
  
Define and maintain standards for responsible AI use, roles and permissions, human oversight, model and agent usage, and acceptable business practices.
  
  
Ensure governance is enabling rather than bureaucratic, maintaining appropriate control for the risk and scale of each use case.
  
  
**Adoption, literacy and capability**
Own the enterprise AI adoption strategy, including personas, target behaviours, adoption measures, literacy pathways, champion communities and change interventions.
  
  
Lead the AI literacy, enablement and community agenda so employees can use approved AI tools confidently, safely and productively.
  
  
Sponsor practical adoption programmes, onboarding waves, white-glove support and feedback loops that convert platform access into sustained use and measurable business value.
  
  
Partner with business leaders to identify barriers to adoption, strengthen local ownership and embed AI into priority workflows.
  
  
Establish repeatable adoption and value-realisation practices—baselines, target measures, review cadence and improvement actions—so AI becomes reliably and sustainably embedded in business workflows.
  
  
**Leadership and collaboration**
Manage and develop a small team of AI strategy, governance, platform and adoption resources, setting clear objectives and collaboration practices.
  
  
Act as a key business and platform interface for AI with executive stakeholders, business functions, enterprise architecture, security, finance, procurement and vendors.
  
  
Establish operating rhythms that connect strategy, demand, governance, platform requirements and adoption readiness to delivery priorities.
  
  
Represent the organization in relevant vendor and industry conversations; assess emerging capabilities for strategic relevance and controlled adoption.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Significant experience leading enterprise AI, digital platforms, cloud platforms or technology-enabled transformation in a global, complex organization.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop strategy, operating processes and multi-year roadmaps that connect business priorities, technology choices and measurable value.
  
  
Strong experience in platform adoption, product or service management, governance, change, enablement or portfolio prioritization.
  
  
Sound judgment in responsible AI, privacy, security, model risk and governance, with the ability to make pragmatic, proportionate decisions.
  
  
Experience managing senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams and external technology partners.
  
  
Ability to communicate a compelling AI vision and translate it into practical decisions, programmes and adoption actions for executive, business and technical audiences.
  
  
Strong analytical and commercial skills, including business cases, vendor evaluation, benefit tracking and investment prioritization.
  
  
Fluent English, written and spoken.

**JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility**

* Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams.
* Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap.
* Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths.
* Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition.
* Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces.
* Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation.
* Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation.
* Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness.
* Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up.
* Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees.
* Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control.
* Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle.
* Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity.
* Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved.
* Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required.
  
  
Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving.
  
  
At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure.
  
  
Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
* New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
* Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
* Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories.
* Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue.
* Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
* Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
* Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
* Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.
* Front Loading and Industrial Strategy: Lead early feasibility, manufacturing concept, footprint, capacity, investment and timing assessments for large, complex programs. Challenge assumptions early and convert lessons learned into robust launch concepts

title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description:
Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)

Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time 

About Voice Arena

Voice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.

We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.

Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:

* Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.
* Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.
* Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.
* A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.

About the role

Voice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.

We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.

The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?

This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.

In this role, you will

The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.
2. Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.
3. Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.
4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.
5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.
6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.

In a typical week, you might:

* Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day
* Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team
* Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them
* Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts
* Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

What matters most

Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.

1. Reaching the right people

Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:

* Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.
* Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.
* Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.
* Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:

* Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.
* Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.
* Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.
* Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.
* Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

What we offer

* High ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.
* A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.
* Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.
* Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.

Minimum qualifications

* 2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused company
* A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself
* Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption
* Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it
* Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated
* High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

Preferred qualifications

*You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.*

* Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting
* An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators
* Experience running creator or influencer campaigns
* Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)
* Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

Why join Voice Arena

* Shape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.
* See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.

title: Account Technology
description:
**Overview**
Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership in PSU / Government space, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team.
  
  
Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives.
  
  
Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities.
  
  
Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings.
  
  
Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning.
  
  
Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer and Industry Insights
  
  
Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) and thought leadership to identify and inform the development of the right Industry Sales Kits and industry partners within the customer's vertical industry. Articulates and understands specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry. Leverages industry trends from other industries to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries. Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
  
  
Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
  
  
Differentiated Value Proposition
  
  
Partners with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long-term growth and success. Provides an outside-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
  
  
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.
  
  
Education and Thought Leadership
  
  
Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams.
  
  
Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high-stakes customers, and all-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.
  
  
Mapping and Account Planning
  
  
Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
  
  
Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
  
  
Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
  
  
Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
  
  
Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
  
  
Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
  
  
Technology Strategy Formulation
  
  
Creates mid- and long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
  
  
Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end-to-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
  
  
Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
  
  
Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
  
  
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
  
  
Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker [TDM]/business decision maker [BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
6+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
  
  
6+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
The Optum Technology Consumer Engineering organization is transforming how millions of people experience healthcare. As part of Optum's Chief Digital Office (CDO), we deliver digital first, personalized experiences that help consumers find, access, and navigate care, leveraging modern cloud platforms, data, AI, and conversational technologies at national scale.
  
  
Serving UnitedHealth Group's digital technology needs, the CDO organization supports experiences used by more than 30 million UnitedHealthcare members. Our mission is to radically improve how consumers and providers engage with the healthcare system by delivering intuitive, personalized, and trustworthy digital experiences across the healthcare journey.
  
  
Technical Product Managers within the CDO own the definition and delivery of complex, cross team digital and agentic experiences that are critical to Optum's consumer strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with business product managers, UX designers, engineers, architects, and fellow technical product managers to translate business priorities and user insights into well defined, outcome driven member experiences.
  
  
As a Technical Product Manager, you will translate strategy and lead execution across multiple teams and systems, operating with a high degree of autonomy. You will also lead AI accelerated product development and responsibly integrate AI into consumer experiences to improve speed, quality, and member outcomes.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Understand needs and define opportunities

+ Partner with business product and domain stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, and digital experience trends
+ Translate insights into clearly articulated, outcome driven opportunities that align with business priorities and consumer value

* Develop and support product roadmaps

+ Collaborate with business product counterparts to articulate strategy, prioritize opportunities, and define multi quarter roadmaps
+ Assess feasibility, dependencies, and costs to ensure roadmaps are executable and aligned with investment guardrails

* Define executable experiences and enhancements

+ Partner with UX, engineering, and architecture leaders to elaborate opportunities into clearly defined experiences, features, and enhancements
+ Ensure requirements and success metrics are unambiguous, testable, and aligned to intended member outcomes

* Technical fluency and solution partnership

+ Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to understand end to end system flows, technical constraints, and solution options
+ Evaluate technical alternatives, decompose complex problems into executable increments, and define requirements for dependent teams and systems

* Drive successful execution

+ Lead execution across multiple teams and platforms, sequencing work across dependencies and influencing backlog prioritization and trade off decisions
+ Proactively identify, manage, and resolve cross team risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate effectively when needed
+ Ensure delivery of high quality outcomes while managing costs within allocated budgets

* Champion AI accelerated product development and AI infused experiences

+ Champion the effective use of AI tools across product discovery, definition, delivery, and operations to improve speed and quality
+ Identify and elaborate opportunities to responsibly incorporate AI into member experiences, with clear measurement, monitoring, and feedback loops

* Operational excellence

+ Deeply understand how experiences perform in production, including usage, member sentiment, quality metrics, and operational issues
+ Use data and feedback to identify improvement opportunities and inform roadmap and prioritization decisions

* Executive ready communication

+ Communicate progress, trade offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders
+ Articulate value through concise narratives, artifacts, and data backed insights tailored to both technical and non technical audiences

* Leadership and mentorship

+ Provide mentorship and informal leadership to other technical product managers
+ Raise the bar for product definition, execution rigor, and cross functional collaboration within the TPM community

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in technical or software product management, or closely related roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex, technology enabled digital products using modern product discovery and delivery practices
* Demonstrated solid ability to partner with and influence business, UX, engineering, architecture, and data teams
* Proven ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity, complexity, and cross portfolio dependencies
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the healthcare industry
* Experience delivering consumer facing web and mobile digital experiences at scale
* Experience integrating AI responsibly into customer facing digital products with measurable outcomes
* Experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, definition, delivery, and/or operational maturity
* Demonstrated solid presentation and storytelling skills, with experience influencing senior leaders

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes , an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Trialion AI is an AI-native eClinical suite built on a single continuous data model, unifying EDC, ePRO/eCOA, RTSM, eConsent, medical coding, and site CTMS into one product. Every module reads and writes the same records under a single immutable audit trail, eliminating system reconciliation, connector validation, and data migration during protocol amendments. The platform is designed for rapid study build, live deployment of amendments, and data quality at the point of entry, with AI-assisted workflows always overseen and approved by qualified clinical data professionals. Trialion AI is architected to meet global regulatory standards including 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ICH E6(R3), CDSCO Schedule Y, and the DPDP Act 2023. Built by clinical data and engineering leaders from IQVIA, Vidia, and Aerial Borne, it serves agile CROs, mid-market biopharma, and medical device companies running trials across India and APAC.

**Role Description**
The Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant is a full-time, hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role focuses on shaping product strategy for Trialion’s eClinical platform while ensuring that clinical trial operations are efficient, compliant, and aligned with sponsor and CRO needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include translating trial workflows and regulatory requirements into product features, collaborating with product managers and engineers on study build and data lifecycle design, and conducting operational analyses to improve site and sponsor experiences. The consultant will engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, prioritize product enhancements, and support the design and rollout of new modules and capabilities. The role also involves preparing documentation and operational playbooks, contributing to go-to-market activities, and supporting cross-functional teams in India and APAC.

**Qualifications**

* Strong product strategy and product management skills, with the ability to define vision, roadmap, and use cases for eClinical solutions.
* Excellent analytical skills and research capabilities to evaluate clinical operations, user needs, and market trends.
* Experience in product development within clinical trials or healthcare technology, including collaboration with engineering and design teams.
* Solid understanding of clinical trial operations, data management, and regulatory frameworks such as ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
* Prior experience working with CROs, biopharma, or medical device organizations, ideally in India or APAC, US markets.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and operational concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Demonstrated capability to work in a hybrid environment, managing onsite collaboration in Gurugram and remote responsibilities independently.

title: Product Manager/ Senior Product Manager – Travel Tech

description:

title: Intern, Founder's Office
description:
**About us**

BrightSense is building technology for the AI age. Its first product is Branly, an AI visibility platform.

How people discover brands has changed. More and more, they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers what to buy, and those answers name only a handful of brands. Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* **Grounded in research.**
  AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* **Signal over noise.**
  We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* **Customer first.**
  Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring an Intern in the Founder's Office to work directly with the founding team across growth, product, research and operations.

You will run projects end to end: launch campaigns, read user data, speak to customers, test product releases, research competitors and keep day-to-day work moving. Some projects will be planned. Others will come up because something needs fixing that day.

We are an AI-first team. AI is how we research, write, analyse and build, not an add-on. You will be expected to work the same way: hand the first pass to AI, check it properly, and spend your own time on judgement and the parts that need a human.

You will learn how the business works by working across it. We are looking for someone who asks good questions, figures things out and takes a task through to completion.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* **AI-first execution.**
  Use AI tools as your default way of working across research, writing, analysis and reporting. Build simple, repeatable workflows the team can reuse, check every output before it goes anywhere, and share what saves time.
* **Growth and go-to-market.**
  Run outbound and paid experiments end to end: list building, copywriting, campaign execution and performance analysis. Track what works, recommend what to change and stop what does not.
* **User funnel.**
  Track the journey from sign-up to activation and paid conversion. Find where users drop off, investigate why and work with the team to close the gaps.
* **User communication and channels.**
  Write and send the messages that move users forward: onboarding emails, follow-ups, reminders, community posts and content. Own each piece from first draft to publishing, and measure how users respond.
* **Cohort and segment analysis.**
  Use tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel or similar to understand how different user groups behave. Spot patterns, explain what they mean and recommend what to do next.
* **Direct user feedback.**
  Call and message users to understand what is and is not working. Capture feedback in their own words and bring clear findings back to the founding team.
* **Product testing and improvement.**
  Test upcoming releases, catch bugs before customers do and document issues the team can act on. Turn user feedback and funnel gaps into specific product ideas.
* **Competitor and market research.**
  Research competitors and relevant tools. Understand their pricing, strengths and differentiators, and identify where Branly can do better.
* **Operations and urgent priorities.**
  Take ownership of work across vendors, spreadsheets, hiring pipelines, launches and other operational needs. Keep information organised, follow up with the right people and close open tasks.
* **Learn the product inside out.**
  Use Branly the way our customers do. Understand how brands show up in AI answers, so your work in growth, research and support is grounded in the product.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who wants hands-on experience building and running a business.
* You have taken ownership of something and finished it. This could be an internship project, a campus initiative, a side project or something you built yourself.
* AI-first by habit. You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day, you have used them to get real work done, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can spot a pattern, investigate a drop-off and suggest a concrete fix.
* A clear writer who can put together an email, campaign message or research note that gets to the point.
* Comfortable calling or messaging users, customers and vendors directly to get feedback or move work forward.
* Curious about startups, B2B software and marketing. You take an interest in how products find users and turn them into customers.
* Organised enough to manage several tasks, keep people updated and follow through without repeated reminders.

**Bonus points**

* You have built something with AI: an automation, a custom GPT or Claude project, or a workflow that replaced manual work.
* Hands-on experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools.
* You have run an email campaign, built an online community, created content or tested a paid campaign.
* Experience testing a product and documenting bugs clearly.
* You have built a side project, worked at a startup or helped run an online business.

**What it is like working with us**

* **Build in one of marketing's most in-demand categories.**
  More brands want to understand how AI talks about them. You will help build a product that answers that question.
* **Learn to work the AI-first way.**
  You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with workflows and habits most teams are still figuring out.
* **High ownership, high visibility.**
  You will work side by side with the founders. Your work ships fast, and you will see what it changes.
* **A seat close to the decisions.**
  You will see how growth, product and operations connect, and help shape what the team does next.
* **Learn from founders who have scaled before.**
  You will work closely with a team that has led and grown operations across industries, and you will pick up how it is done.
* **Grow as fast as you learn.**
  As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger projects and more responsibility.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Group Product Manager – Payments**
to lead the strategy, development, and optimisation of payment platforms and customer payment experiences.

The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in
**payment gateways, card payments, network tokenisation, payment routing, and payment orchestration**
, with a proven track record of building and scaling payment products.

This role requires strong product leadership, technical understanding of payment infrastructure, and the ability to work closely with Engineering, Payment Gateways, Banking Partners, and Business teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing payment solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Payment Gateway Integrations & Payment Infrastructure

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for payment gateway integrations, payment processing, and payment infrastructure.
* Drive integrations with multiple payment gateways, acquiring banks, payment processors, and payment service providers.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of
  **credit cards, debit cards, direct debit, banking payments, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and alternative payment methods**
  .
* Work closely with external payment partners to build reliable, scalable, and seamless payment solutions.
* Own the end-to-end payment transaction lifecycle, including authorisation, capture, refunds, settlement, and transaction failures.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve payment reliability, scalability, and transaction success rates.

2. Card Tokenisation & Payment Security

* Lead product initiatives around
  **card tokenisation across Visa, Mastercard, Diners Club, RuPay, and other card networks**
  .
* Define product requirements for network tokenisation, secure card storage, and saved payment instruments.
* Work with Engineering, Compliance, and Payment Partners to implement secure and compliant tokenisation solutions.
* Drive improvements in payment security, customer convenience, and recurring payment experiences.
* Ensure alignment with PCI-DSS, card network regulations, and applicable payment security standards.

3. Payment Routing & Orchestration

* Own the product roadmap for
  **payment routing and orchestration capabilities**
  across multiple gateways, banks, and payment methods.
* Drive the development of manual, rule-based, and automated payment routing solutions.
* Define intelligent routing strategies based on payment success rates, gateway performance, transaction costs, payment methods, and customer experience.
* Partner with Engineering teams to implement payment failover, fallback mechanisms, and retry strategies.
* Continuously optimise payment acceptance rates, transaction success rates, latency, and processing costs.
* Use data-driven insights to identify opportunities for improving payment performance and operational efficiency.

4. Payment Experience & Checkout Optimisation (Good to Have)

* Own and enhance the end-to-end customer payment journey, including payment pages and checkout experiences.
* Define product strategies for payment method ordering, saved cards, preferred payment methods, and seamless checkout.
* Drive intelligent payment retry logic and payment recovery journeys to reduce transaction failures.
* Improve checkout conversion, payment success rates, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Partner with Design, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver intuitive and frictionless payment experiences.

5. Product Strategy & Leadership

* Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for the payments ecosystem.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Engineering, Business, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and external payment partners.
* Translate complex payment infrastructure requirements into scalable product solutions.
* Own product prioritisation, business cases, success metrics, and execution.
* Drive product decisions through customer insights, transaction analytics, experimentation, and business impact.
* Mentor Product Managers and build strong product management practices across the payments domain.

Required Skills & Experience

* **11–15 years of overall experience**
  , with significant experience in Product Management and payment-related products.
* Proven experience owning payment products within a payment gateway, payment aggregator, FinTech, banking, or large-scale product organisation.
* Deep functional and technical understanding of
  **card payments, payment gateways, direct debit, banking payments, and digital wallets**
  .
* Strong experience managing payment gateway integrations and working directly with payment service providers.
* Hands-on product ownership experience in
  **card tokenisation**
  , preferably across Visa, Mastercard, Diners Club, and RuPay.
* Proven experience building or managing
  **payment routing engines, smart routing, or payment orchestration platforms**
  .
* Strong understanding of payment APIs, transaction processing, payment architecture, and distributed payment systems.
* Demonstrated ability to work closely with Engineering teams on complex payment infrastructure products.
* Strong analytical skills with experience improving payment success rates, transaction conversion, and processing efficiency.
* Excellent stakeholder management, product strategy, execution, and leadership capabilities.

Good to Have

* Experience owning checkout and customer-facing payment experiences.
* Experience with Apple Pay, Google Pay, recurring payments, and alternative payment methods.
* Exposure to saved cards, payment method prioritisation, one-click checkout, and intelligent retry logic.
* Experience with cross-border payments or large-scale international payment platforms.
* Prior experience managing Product Managers or leading multiple payment product workstreams.

Preferred Candidate Background

Candidates with relevant payments product experience from organisations such as:

**Payment Gateways & FinTech:**
Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, Stripe, Adyen, Checkout.com, Worldpay, CCAvenue, or similar companies.

**E-commerce & Consumer Technology:**
Amazon, Flipkart, PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or other product-based organisations with sophisticated payments infrastructure.

Experience building and scaling complex payments products will be prioritised over company pedigree.

Key Success Metrics

* Improvement in overall payment success and authorisation rates.
* Reduction in payment processing costs and gateway failures.
* Improved transaction routing efficiency and reliability.
* Successful rollout and adoption of card tokenisation capabilities.
* Reduction in payment latency and transaction drop-offs.
* Improvement in checkout conversion and payment completion rates, where applicable.

What Makes an Ideal Candidate?

We are looking for a
**strong, technically sound Product Leader who has directly owned and built payment products**
, not someone whose experience is limited to payment operations, merchant onboarding, or basic gateway integrations.

The ideal candidate should bring:

1. **Deep Payments Domain Expertise:**
   Strong knowledge of cards, banking payments, and payment gateway ecosystems.
2. **Card Tokenisation Ownership:**
   Experience driving network tokenisation initiatives across major card networks.
3. **Payment Routing Expertise:**
   Proven ownership of payment routing, orchestration, and transaction optimisation products.
4. **Strong Technical Product Management:**
   Ability to partner with Engineering teams on complex payment infrastructure.
5. **Strategic Product Leadership:**
   Ability to define roadmaps, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable business outcomes.

title: IT Operations Assoc Manager - Digital Transformation (Supply Chain)
description:
**Overview**
The primary objective of this role is to enable, optimize, and digitally transform the end-to-end supply chain by designing, delivering, and sustaining technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, service levels, cost performance, and business agility.
  
  
The role acts as a strategic partner to Supply Chain functions—
**Planning, Procurement, Agro, Manufacturing, EHS, Quality, Warehousing, Logistics, and Customer Service**
—to ensure technology investments drive tangible business outcomes.
  
  
The purpose and scope of the role is to:
  
  

* Align Supply Chain business needs with digital & IT capabilities by deeply understanding functional processes and pain points.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives that leverage automation, analytics, AI/ML, and integrated platforms to modernize supply chain operations.
* Ensure seamless orchestration of systems and data across multiple functions and partners to support real-time visibility and decision-making.
* Serve as the bridge between business teams and technical teams, enabling solutions that are technically robust, scalable, secure, reasonable in cost and deliver the intended value.
* Enable continuous improvement and adoption, ensuring that solutions are effectively utilized and continually enhanced to meet evolving business needs.
* Engage cross-functional teams including Finance/Controls, Sales, R&D, Engineering and other external supply chain partners to ensure seamless integration of IT capabilities with business processes.

**Responsibilities**
**Business Engagement & Requirement Management**

* Act as the primary IT partner for Supply Chain teams across Planning, Manufacturing, Agro, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Customer Service.
* Proactively identify digital opportunities and pain points by engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
* Gather, validate, and translate functional requirements into clear solution specifications.
* Ensure alignment of all initiatives with supply chain strategy and enterprise architecture.

**Solution Design & Functional Leadership**

* Lead functional solution design for key Supply Chain processes (e.g. transportation, logistics, warehousing, Agro etc)
* Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions based on fit, scalability, cost, and integration needs.
* Set up and actively lead design workshops, process mapping sessions, and blueprint creation.
* Ensure data, process, and integration consistency across applications.

**Project & Program Delivery**

* End-to-end ownership of digital initiatives, including planning, vendor coordination, execution, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Drive cross-functional teams to meet timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Conduct and coordinate for UAT (user acceptance test) cycles, ensuring scenarios reflect true operational needs.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.

**Stakeholder Communication & Change Management**

* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and decisions needed.
* Prepare communication materials, training documentation, and user onboarding content.
* Foster a culture of digital adoption, helping users confidently leverage new tools and systems.

**Data & Analytics Enablement**

* Support accurate and timely data flows across systems.
* Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver dashboards, KPIs, and predictive insights.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and integration integrity across supply chain applications.

**Value Delivery & Performance Tracking**

* Track benefits realization of IT investments (cost savings, service improvements, automation benefits).
* Ensure digital initiatives directly support supply chain KPIs
* Present performance insights and improvement opportunities to leadership teams.

**Continuous Improvement & Digital Optimization**

* Identify automation, simplification, and digitization opportunities across supply chain processes.
* Lead process improvement initiatives using analytics and automation.
* Influence adoption through training, communication, and capability-building interventions.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure solutions follow IT and cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and audit guidelines.
* Maintain strong controls around change management, access management, and data protection.
* Represent Supply Chain IT in governance forums and architecture councils.

**Application Operations & Support**

* Ensure day-to-day stability, performance, and availability of supply chain applications.
* Act as the escalation point for high-priority incidents and coordinate resolution with support teams.
* Drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes to minimize repeated issues.
* Maintain system documentation, SOPs, and configuration records.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Coordinate with technology vendors, implementation partners, and managed service teams.
* Evaluate vendor deliverables, quality, SLAs, and compliance.
* Ensure external partners understand business context and deliver solutions aligned with expectations.

**Qualifications**
**Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Masters in Business Management
* 10–12 years of experience in Supply Chain IT, Digital, or Business-facing roles through Consulting assignments.
* Experience delivering or supporting large-scale digital transformation programs in FMCG or related industries.
* Proven experience in multi-stakeholder, cross-functional environments.
* Exposure to global or multi-market operations

**Technical & Systems Knowledge**

* Advanced Planning Systems (e.g. APO, Blue Yonder)
* WMS/TMS solutions (e.g. Blue Yonder, SAP EWM/TM)
* Control Tower platforms
* ERP (SAP ECC/S4HANA – core MM, PP, SD modules)
* Understanding of integration technologies (APIs, EDI, IDocs, event-driven platforms).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure) and their use in enterprise applications.

title: Quick Commerce Expert
description:
**About Dr. Veda**

Dr. Veda Private Limited is a fast-growing D2C beauty and wellness brand focused on creating high-quality, performance-driven products for modern consumers. We are building a strong digital-first presence through innovative marketing strategies, impactful storytelling, and data-driven growth campaigns.

We are looking for a
**Quick Commerce Expert**

**1. Platform Ownership & Growth**

- Own P&L for all Quick Commerce platforms

- Manage end-to-end account management, listings, cataloging, and content optimization

- Drive growth in GMV, market share, and repeat rates across platforms

**2. Strategy & Execution**

- Develop platform-wise pricing, promotions, and visibility strategy

- Plan and execute campaigns, platform ads, and banner placements to maximize SOV

- Identify assortment gaps and launch NPDs relevant for Q-commerce

**3. Operations & Supply Chain Coordination**

- Manage dark store mapping, inventory planning, and fill-rate optimization

- Coordinate with demand planning & warehouse teams to ensure >95% serviceability

- Monitor OOS, TAT, return %, and resolve operational issues with platform KAMs

**4. Data & Performance**

- Track daily KPIs: Sales, CTR, CVR, ROAS, Visibility, Share of Search, OOS%

- Build weekly business reviews and drive insights for growth

- Benchmark competition on pricing, assortment, offers, and visibility

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with Marketing, Design, Finance, and Supply Chain teams

- Liaise with platform Category Managers and KAMs for JBP and growth opportunities

**Requirements:**

- Minimum 4+ years of experience managing Quick Commerce or Marketplaces (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon, Flipkart)

- Proven track record of scaling a D2C / FMCG / Beauty / Food brand on Q-commerce

- Strong understanding of Q-commerce algorithms, ads manager, and dark store operations

- Proficient in Excel / Google Sheets, data analytics, and platform dashboards

- Strong negotiation and relationship management skills with platform KAMs

- Bachelor's degree in Business/Marketing; MBA preferred

**Good to Have:**

- Experience in D2C / FMCG / Personal Care / Food & Beverage category

- Knowledge of tools like Unicommerce, EasyEcom, or similar OMS/WMS

- Experience in Joint Business Planning (JBP) with Q-commerce platforms

**KPIs for Success:**

GMV & Revenue Growth, Share of Category, Fill Rate & OOS %, Ad Spend Efficiency (ROAS), Visibility & SOV, New Dark Store Addition

**What We Offer:**

Competitive salary, growth ownership in a high-growth D2C brand, direct access to founders, and fast-track career growth.
