The Online Business Entrepreneur at health and wealth will lead the development, launch, and growth of online business initiatives in the health and wellness space. This full-time on-site role, based in Delhi, India, involves identifying market opportunities, designing digital offerings, and managing end-to-end execution of online projects. Day-to-day tasks include conducting market and competitor research, defining business models, coordinating with designers and content creators, overseeing digital marketing campaigns, and monitoring performance metrics such as traffic, conversion, and revenue. The role requires hands-on involvement in optimizing websites and online funnels, building strategic partnerships, and testing new ideas to drive sustainable growth. The Online Business Entrepreneur will also be responsible for maintaining high standards of customer experience and ensuring all activities align with the brand values and compliance requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong entrepreneurial mindset with experience in launching or managing online businesses, e-commerce projects, or digital startups.
* Knowledge of digital marketing concepts such as social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), online advertising, and email marketing.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze data, and translate insights into practical business strategies and action plans.
* Solid understanding of online sales funnels, customer acquisition, and conversion optimization techniques.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.
* Comfort with digital tools and platforms, including website management systems, analytics tools, and productivity software.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Entrepreneurship, or a related field; relevant certifications or proven experience may be considered in place of formal education.
* Self-motivated, organized, and willing to take ownership of projects in a fast-moving, growth-oriented environment.
* Interest in the health and wellness sector and commitment to ethical, customer-centric business practices.

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.**
  You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can investigate problems across the stack.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**
  AI tools are part of how you build. You know how to give them useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

* Tell us about a product or feature you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned from users after launch.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India's leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we're building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a data-driven and entrepreneurial Product Manager to identify customer problems, develop product solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes. The role involves managing the complete product lifecycle, from discovery and experimentation to development, launch, and adoption. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities, customer understanding, and execution skills to deliver impactful product improvements.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Product Discovery: Conduct customer and user research, analyse product usage data, understand existing workflows, and identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Product Prioritisation: Evaluate opportunities based on customer value, business impact, implementation effort, and technical dependencies to prioritise product initiatives.
* Experimentation & Validation: Design and execute product experiments by defining hypotheses, establishing baselines, determining test methodologies, and setting success metrics and guardrails. Analyse outcomes to determine next steps.
* Product Analytics: Analyse product and business data to identify trends, investigate root causes, measure adoption, and evaluate the impact of product changes on downstream outcomes.
* Product Development: Translate customer and business requirements into user journeys, product specifications, edge cases, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with Design and Engineering teams throughout development.
* Technical Collaboration: Work with Engineering teams to understand APIs, integrations, system constraints, and implementation trade-offs, ensuring effective product decisions.
* Product Launch & Adoption: Define launch criteria, coordinate releases and staged rollouts where required, and monitor adoption, reliability, and customer feedback after launch.
* Performance Measurement: Evaluate whether shipped features achieve their intended objectives and initiate further improvements or rollbacks based on performance data.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve product functionality, user experience, workflow efficiency, and business performance through ongoing analysis and experimentation.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have a proven track record of independently designing and executing multiple product experiments with demonstrable results.
* Possess strong analytical skills and the ability to independently analyse data, investigate root causes, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
* Have practical experience with SQL or data analysis tools; SQL proficiency is an added advantage.
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make informed decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Have experience translating customer needs and business objectives into product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Possess the ability to collaborate effectively with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong ownership of product initiatives, from problem identification through implementation and outcome measurement.
* Show genuine curiosity about customer behaviour, product development, and business growth, with examples of how this has influenced product decisions or personal projects.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on products that address meaningful challenges across the D2C and eCommerce ecosystem. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, use data and experimentation to guide product decisions, and contribute to building scalable solutions that improve customer experience and business performance.

title: AI Product Owner - Agentic AI | Insurance / BFSI | Gurugram
description:
**About the client:**
A leading insurance company is building out its Enterprise AI & Decision Intelligence function and is hiring AI Product Owners to drive Agentic AI adoption across the business.

**Location:**
Gurugram (work from office, 5 days a week)

**Experience:**
5–12 years (hiring at Manager and Senior Manager levels)

**Notice period:**
Immediate to 30 days preferred

**The role**

You will be the bridge between business stakeholders and AI delivery teams – identifying, prioritising and delivering AI-powered use cases and AI agents that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Key responsibilities**

• Identify and shape enterprise AI use cases aligned to business priorities, and define success criteria and KPIs

• Design Agentic AI workflows – break business processes into agent tasks, orchestration flows, decision points, guardrails and human-in-the-loop escalations

• Own and prioritise the AI product backlog based on business value, ROI, feasibility, compliance and operational risk

• Translate business requirements into AI user stories, agent workflows and sprint-ready requirements

• Act as the single point of contact between business owners and AI delivery pods; run requirement workshops with business, operations, risk, compliance and technology teams

• Work with AI Engineers, Data Scientists and Architects through solution reviews, UAT, pilots and production rollout

• Ensure solutions follow Responsible AI principles (fairness, transparency, explainability, auditability) and enterprise data privacy, security and compliance standards

• Define data requirements and feedback loops with data teams

• Track value realised – automation %, turnaround time, productivity, customer and employee experience – and drive adoption and change management

**What we are looking for**

• 5–12 years in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Transformation or AI programs

• Hands-on experience delivering GenAI / LLM-based solutions or automation platforms into production

• Strong understanding of AI, GenAI and Agentic AI concepts and enterprise use cases

• Domain experience in Insurance, Banking or Fintech (BFSI) – insurance exposure is a plus

• Familiarity with APIs, enterprise systems and orchestration platforms such as Copilot Studio, Pega, LangChain or CrewAI

• Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery and working with cross-functional AI or analytics teams

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

Interested candidates may apply here or share their profile. All applications will be treated in strict confidence.

title: Product Manager (Technical)
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Technical Manager**
to own the end-to-end delivery of technology products across
**web, mobile and enterprise platforms**
.

The role will work closely with
**business stakeholders, internal engineering teams and external technology vendors**
, translating business requirements into clear technical scope and driving execution through development, testing, release and post-production support.

This is a
**hands-on technology delivery and product ownership role**
, focused on execution, technical oversight, stakeholder management and delivery governance rather than people management or enterprise architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Program & Delivery Management

* Own technology initiatives end-to-end, including
  **scope, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and release timelines**
  .
* Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming and release cycles with internal engineering and external vendor teams.
* Identify and proactively escalate
  **risks, blockers and dependencies**
  .
* Maintain delivery dashboards and provide regular reporting to leadership.
* Manage multiple technology initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong governance and delivery discipline.

2. Requirements & Product Ownership

* Translate business requirements into
  **user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specifications**
  .
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business priorities.
* Balance and communicate trade-offs between
  **scope, timelines and technical debt**
  .
* Define release success metrics and track product adoption and business impact after go-live.
* Lead
  **UAT, defect triage, business sign-off and post-release support**
  .
* Demonstrate the ability to challenge requirements and understand/reframe the underlying business problem.

3. Technical Oversight

* Review technical designs with a focus on
  **scalability, security, performance and maintainability**
  .
* Identify technical deviations and escalate them appropriately.
* Coordinate
  **API design, system integrations and data flows**
  across internal and third-party platforms.
* Support build-vs-buy decisions and vendor selection through structured technical evaluation.
* Maintain technical documentation, integration maps and environment inventories.

4. Cloud, DevOps & Release Management

* Coordinate application deployments and releases across cloud environments.
* Work with engineering teams on
  **CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance**
  .
* Own mobile application release cycles, version management and app-store compliance.
* Monitor application uptime, crash analytics and production incidents.
* Drive root-cause analysis and ensure production issues are closed effectively.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

* Act as the key interface between
  **business teams and technology delivery teams**
  .
* Manage external vendors against
  **SOW scope, milestones, acceptance criteria and SLAs**
  .
* Handle vendor escalations and ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Guide developers, QA teams and vendor resources on delivery standards.
* Present program status, key risks, decisions and dependencies to senior leadership.

**Technical Skills & Expertise**

The ideal candidate should have strong depth in at least one technology stack along with hands-on exposure to cloud, DevOps and release management. Depth and practical experience are more important than having broad exposure to every technology listed below.

Cloud & DevOps – Mandatory

* AWS or Azure
* Azure DevOps or AWS CodePipeline
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Infrastructure and deployment automation

APIs & System Integration – Mandatory

* REST APIs
* Microservices
* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures
* Authentication
* Enterprise system integration

Backend – Strong proficiency in at least one

* Node.js
* Java
* .NET
* Ruby on Rails

Frontend – Working knowledge

* React.js
* Next.js

Mobile – Working knowledge

* React Native
* Flutter
* .NET MAUI
* Android
* iOS

Release & Production Monitoring – Mandatory

* Google Play Console
* Apple App Store
* Firebase
* Crash analytics
* Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
* Production support and incident management

Delivery Tools & Data – Mandatory

* Jira or Azure Boards
* Confluence
* SQL
* Basic data analysis

Enterprise Platforms – Preferred

* ERP implementation/integration
* CRM implementation/integration
* HRMS implementation/integration

Emerging Technologies – Preferred

* AI and GenAI tools applied to business workflows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required**

* **5–7 years of experience**
  in technology delivery, with
  **2–3 years of independently managing technology programs**
  .
* Bachelor's degree in
  **Computer Science, Engineering or an equivalent discipline**
  .
* Hands-on development background is preferred.
* Proven experience delivering at least one
  **large enterprise platform or customer-facing application**
  end-to-end.
* Ability to understand, review and challenge technical designs without necessarily writing production code.
* Experience working in
  **Agile or hybrid delivery environments**
  , including backlog management and sprint governance.
* Experience managing
  **external technology vendors or system integrators**
  .
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to prepare requirements documents, status reports and escalation notes.

**Preferred**

* **Product Management / Product Ownership experience**
  , including roadmap ownership, prioritization based on business outcomes or user discovery.
* Experience with consumer-facing mobile applications and app-store release cycles.
* Experience in
  **real estate, hospitality or other asset-heavy, operations-intensive industries**
  .
* Relevant certifications such as:
* PMP
* CSM
* CSPO
* SAFe
* AWS Associate-level certification
* Azure Associate-level certification.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

The role will be evaluated on:

Program Delivery

* On-time milestone completion
* Scope variance
* Sprint predictability
* Sign-off cycle time

Requirement & Product Quality

* UAT defect density
* Post-sign-off change rate
* Feature adoption at 30 and 90 days

Release & Platform Stability

* Release success rate
* Production defect rate
* Crash-free rate
* Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR)
* Mobile store release cycle time

Engineering Standards

* Design review compliance
* Vulnerability closure time
* Integration failure rate
* Technical documentation completeness

Vendor & Cost Management

* First-submission milestone acceptance
* SLA adherence
* Change requests as a percentage of contract value.

**Core Competencies**

**The successful candidate should demonstrate:**

* **Structured problem-solving**
* **Strong ownership and bias towards closure**
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to
  **non-technical stakeholders**
* Strong prioritization and decision-making under constraints
* Comfort working with ambiguity
* Strong vendor negotiation and escalation judgment
* High attention to detail, particularly around
  **scope, requirements and acceptance criteria**
  .

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a
**technology delivery professional with a strong technical foundation and product mindset**
, who can independently take a technology initiative from requirements through development, testing, deployment and post-production support.

They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of
**business, product, engineering and external vendors**
, with the ability to understand technical architecture, challenge requirements, manage delivery risks and ensure that technology solutions deliver measurable business outcomes.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has built something from 0-to-1 or scaled a product through the 10-to-100 stage. You'll own a meaningful slice of our restaurant technology platform, working across a variety of ecosystems products that process billions of transactions annually for QSR and Retail brands globally.
  
  
This role sits inside a product organization that's actively expanding. You'll have real scope, real customer exposure, and real influence on architectural and commercial decisions. You'll also have to earn it as we operate lean, ship fast, and expect you to have opinions.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* End-to-end product ownership for a defined product area within restaurant operating system including roadmap definition, prioritization, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Direct customer relationships with restaurant brands and integration partners including challenging conversations about scope, timelines, and trade-offs.
* PRDs and product decisions that engineering, design, and go-to-market teams can execute against.
* Cross-team coordination with engineering leads in India and the US, product peers, sales engineering, and customer success.
* Data-driven decisions you'll pull your own numbers when you need to and speak to stakeholders by bringing data points and not anecdotes.

**Experience (required)**
**What we're looking for**

* 6-10 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in enterprise SaaS, POS, or payments domains.
* At least one meaningful 0-to-1 launch or one meaningful 10-to-100 scaling journey where you were the primary product manager.
* Direct experience with API-driven platforms, integration ecosystems, or multi-tenant SaaS.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, decision-oriented PRDs.
* Curiosity and demonstrated success at bringing AI-driven use cases into the Product Development life cycle.

**Experience (strongly Preferred)**

* Restaurant tech, retail tech, or vertical SaaS background.
* Experience working across US and India time zones with distributed engineering teams.
* Payments experience payment processors, gateway integrations, refunds/chargebacks, or PCI-adjacent work.

Traits that matter
  
  

* Comfortable with data and bringing those into decision making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Judgment to distinguish "customer said they want X" from "customer needs X".
* Ownership instinct: the person who follows up without being asked, updates JIRA without being reminded, and closes loops without being nagged.
* Ability to push back on senior stakeholders (engineering leadership, sales, executives) with data and reasoning, not deference.

**What We're Not Looking For**

* Someone whose primary product experience is running scrum ceremonies.
* Someone who needs a fully defined problem before they can move.
* Someone who confuses "AI-first" as a resume line with shipping AI-integrated products.

Interview #2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
  
  
Interview #3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)

title: Head of Retail
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are a diversified capital markets and financial services organisation with established capabilities across stock broking, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), algorithmic trading, colocation and high-frequency trading (HFT) platforms.

As part of our growth strategy, we are seeking an experienced Retail Head / President to lead the transformation and scaling of our retail broking and wealth business into a technology-driven, digital-first platform. The role carries end-to-end responsibility for business growth, product strategy, customer experience, technology alignment, and profitability.

The successful candidate will build a differentiated retail investing ecosystem spanning trading, investing, and wealth solutions while driving sustainable business growth and customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Business Strategy & P&L Ownership**

* Own the overall strategy, growth, operating performance and profitability of the digital retail broking business.
* Develop a clear roadmap for transitioning from a traditional full-service brokerage model to a scalable, digital-first operating model.
* Drive customer acquisition, active client growth, trading and investing engagement, customer retention and lifetime value.
* Build sustainable and diversified revenue streams across broking, investment products, margin funding where appropriate, subscriptions and other permissible offerings.
* Establish business metrics, budgets, unit economics and operating dashboards, with accountability for revenue, costs, contribution margins and profitability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage the organisation’s existing market infrastructure and capital markets expertise to create a differentiated retail proposition.

**2. Product Vision & Digital Platform Development**

* Define and execute the product vision for a comprehensive retail trading and investing ecosystem across mobile, web and API-led channels.
* Build a differentiated, intuitive and reliable customer experience covering onboarding, KYC, account funding, trading, investing, portfolio tracking and customer servicing.
* Develop a customer-centric product roadmap using market research, customer insights, behavioural analytics and competitive intelligence.
* Oversee the development of advanced trading tools, charting, options analytics, screeners, alerts, watchlists, APIs, strategy tools and intelligent trading workflows.
* Introduce relevant AI-enabled capabilities for research discovery, portfolio insights, customer support, personalisation and operational efficiency, subject to appropriate controls.
* Build a product-led culture that prioritises customer value, usability, reliability, speed and continuous improvement.

**3. Technology & Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the retail technology organisation, including software engineering, mobile and web development, architecture, DevOps, quality engineering, data, cybersecurity and platform reliability.
* Establish a scalable, resilient and secure technology architecture capable of supporting increasing customer volumes and market activity.
* Drive engineering excellence, release velocity, automation, system observability, disaster recovery and business continuity.
* Build high-performing product and engineering teams with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and strong cross-functional collaboration.
* Make strategic decisions on build versus buy, technology partnerships, cloud and infrastructure architecture, and platform modernisation.
* Ensure close alignment between product, engineering, dealing, risk, operations, compliance and customer support.

**4. Customer Acquisition, Experience & Growth**

* Develop a scalable digital distribution strategy encompassing organic acquisition, referrals, partnerships, performance marketing and other appropriate channels.
* Improve conversion across the customer journey, from prospect acquisition and account opening to first transaction, activation and long-term retention.
* Use customer data and analytics to understand cohorts, engagement, churn, customer profitability and opportunities for improvement.
* Build a differentiated service model through responsive digital support, efficient issue resolution and transparent customer communication.
* Strengthen brand positioning and customer trust through product quality, transparent pricing, reliability and responsible financial services practices.

**5. Wealth Platform & Investment Products**

* Develop a roadmap to expand the retail business from transactional broking into a broader investing and wealth ecosystem.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities across mutual funds, ETFs, bonds, fixed-income products, investment baskets, goal-based investing and other suitable investment solutions.
* Evaluate the development or distribution of digital advisory, portfolio solutions and wealth offerings, including PMS access where appropriate to the customer segment and regulatory framework.
* Build customer segmentation and engagement strategies for first-time investors, active traders, long-term investors and affluent customers.
* Establish the product, distribution, technology and service capabilities required to build a scalable wealth business.
* Create a cohesive customer experience that connects trading, investing and wealth needs while maintaining appropriate suitability, disclosures and regulatory separation.

**6. Innovation, Data & Competitive Differentiation**

* Continuously benchmark the business against leading digital brokers, fintech platforms and emerging wealth technology companies.
* Identify opportunities in automation, APIs, intelligent workflows, data-led personalisation and next-generation trading experiences.
* Translate market and technology developments into commercially viable products rather than innovation for its own sake.
* Build a strong product experimentation framework using customer feedback, measurable hypotheses and controlled rollouts.
* Leverage the organisation’s expertise in execution, algorithmic trading and market infrastructure wherever it can create a meaningful retail advantage.

**7. Risk, Governance & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure that products, technology and business processes operate within applicable SEBI, exchange, depository and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Embed risk management, cybersecurity, data privacy, access controls, surveillance, auditability and resilience into product design and platform architecture.
* Work closely with compliance, legal, risk and operations teams to enable innovation within a robust governance framework.
* Ensure appropriate controls for APIs, algorithmic trading, customer communications, investment distribution and any advisory-related activities.

**8. Leadership & Organisational Transformation**

* Lead the cultural shift from a traditional service-led brokerage to a customer-centric, product-led and technology-driven organisation.
* Attract, develop and retain high-calibre product, engineering, data, growth and business talent.
* Build a strong second line of leadership across product, technology, growth, operations and wealth.
* Establish clear decision rights, agile execution practices and accountability for business outcomes.
* Work closely with the promoter and senior leadership team to translate strategic ambition into a practical, measurable transformation programme.

**Job Requirements:**

* 15+ years of leadership experience in retail broking, fintech, wealth management, digital financial services, or related businesses.
* Demonstrated success in leading or materially contributing to the transformation or scaling of a digital brokerage, fintech, investing platform or comparable consumer technology business.
* Strong understanding of Indian capital markets, retail broking economics, trading and investing products, and the regulatory environment.
* Proven ownership of a business P&L, with demonstrated accountability for revenue growth, customer acquisition, operating efficiency and profitability.
* Experience leading product management and technology teams, with the ability to engage deeply on architecture, engineering, reliability and platform strategy.
* Track record of launching successful products, improving customer experience and scaling digital distribution.
* Demonstrated ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams in a fast-moving, competitive environment.
* Exposure to wealth products, investment platforms, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income or digital investment solutions will be a significant advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, execution orientation, analytical capability and entrepreneurial mindset.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Thinks and acts like a business owner.
* Combines strategic vision with hands-on execution.
* Understands both the customer and the technology behind the product.
* Makes data-driven decisions without losing commercial judgement.
* Builds high-performing teams and creates a culture of ownership.
* Balances growth, customer outcomes, risk and sustainable profitability.

**Measures of Success**

The leader will be evaluated on a balanced scorecard covering:

* Growth in funded accounts, active customers and customer assets.
* Customer acquisition efficiency, activation, retention and lifetime value.
* Revenue growth, contribution margin, cost-to-serve and business profitability.
* Product adoption, customer satisfaction and platform reliability.
* Speed of product development and delivery against the roadmap.
* Successful launch and scaling of wealth and investment offerings.
* Regulatory compliance, cybersecurity and operational resilience.

Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. title: Senior Product Manager, Atlas Agent Engine
description:
We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.
  
  
You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.
  
  
Day to day, that means
  
  

* Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
* Talking to customers — from AI-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
* Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc
* Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Partners, Sales, and Developer Relations—to scope, prioritize, and ship, balancing experimentation with reliability and scale, and driving positioning, launches, and enablement
* Identifying new opportunities autonomously—spotting gaps, shaping problem spaces, researching industry trends and running discovery sessions with customers
* Define and own clear success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize, make trade-offs and communicate impact

You'll develop deep expertise in how companies build AI applications — including agentic workflows, retrieval and memory, evaluation, observability, and deployment patterns.
  
  
How we work
  
  

* Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
* Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together.
* In-person when it matters. The team gets together periodically for planning, relationship-building, and the kind of work that's better done face to face

What you'll bring
  
  

* 5+ years in product management (or equivalent) building platforms, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — ideally in cloud, data, or AI
* Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: from framing the problem and vision through roadmap, execution, launch, and iteration
* Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions
* Strong written and live communication: clear docs, productive meetings, confident stakeholder presentations. This matters more in an async, distributed team — writing is how you lead
* Technical depth sufficient to collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems, cloud services, and AI/ML tooling, and to ask good questions when something is unclear
* Curiosity about AI: you follow how companies are building AI applications — agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG, fine-tuning, or other emerging patterns
* Comfort with ambiguity: you help define the problem, the success metrics, and the path forward. In an early-stage team, this is the job

Bonus points
  
  

* Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products
* Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products
* Experience with enterprise customers on mission-critical workloads
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact

How we'll measure success (30/60/90 days)
  
  
We need someone who can onboard quickly and start driving impact early.
  
  
In your first 30 days, you will:
  
  

* Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work
* Shadow customer calls and internal forums to learn current strategy, open questions, and key stakeholders
* Produce a clear written overview of your product area: current state, key bets, and known gaps

By 60 days, you will
  
  

* Take ownership of a set of customer relationships and run your own discovery conversations each week
* Own and socialize an initial strategy and roadmap proposal for your area, with clear problem statements and success metrics
* Partner with engineering and design to shape and drive at least one scoped initiative into execution

By 90 days, you will
  
  

* Be the go-to owner for your product area, driving prioritization and day-to-day decision-making across functions
* Lead customer- and data-informed iterations on what you’ve shipped, adjusting the roadmap based on what you’re learning
* Contribute to the broader AI application platform strategy with perspectives from your domain, customers, and the field

Why this role
  
  
MongoDB is one of the most widely adopted database platforms in the world, used by tens of thousands of customers — including much of the Fortune 100 and a fast-growing set of AI-native startups. Our cloud platform, Atlas, runs across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
  
  
This role puts you at the center of how MongoDB powers AI applications at scale. You’ll own a critical slice of that story, from strategy through delivery and adoption.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Associate, Gen AI & Agentic AI Commercial Excellence COE, BTS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
The Commercial Excellence CoE is a pivotal function within A&M’s broader global Commercial Excellence practice, serving as the GCC-based hub and Supports Pricing, Sales effectiveness, Customer retention & renewals and other commercial excellence topics working closely with our U.S-based team across both B2C and B2B businesses. Our team plays a critical role in consolidating and scaling A&M’s Commercial Excellence capabilities bringing analytical rigor, commercial insight, and operational know-how to help clients unlock measurable margin improvement. As part of our firm’s continued investment in building out a full spectrum Commercial Excellence offering, the CoE acts as both a capability enabler and innovation engine developing reusable methodologies, diagnostic tools, and accelerators that support pricing transformation initiatives across industries and markets. Joining our team means being at the forefront of Commercial Excellence analytics and strategy, working closely with global teams to deliver high-impact outcomes in an area that is increasingly core to our clients' commercial success.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Product Development & Innovation (Agentic AI for Commercial Excellence)
* Lead the design and development of agentic AI workflows across key Commercial Excellence levers (pricing, churn, revenue analytics, salesforce effectiveness)
* Translate business problems into AI-enabled solution architectures, including:
* Multi-agent systems for decisioning (e.g., pricing recommendations, churn interventions)
* LLM-powered in sight generation and narrative synthesis
* Conversational AI interfaces for tools (e.g., chatbot-driven analytics navigation)
* Build and scale modular, reusable AI accelerators and assets (e.g., Commercial Excellence AI modules, insight engines, recommendation agents)
* Define product roadmap for the AI-enabled Commercial Excellence platform, including integration with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes)
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure scalable, production-grade deployment architectures (APIs, microservices, cloud platforms)
* Continuously optimize systems for performance, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency
* Generative AI & Agentic Systems
* Architect and govern scalable, reusable agentic AI frameworks for enterprise use cases
* Define orchestration and execution patterns for multi-agent systems (event-driven workflows, planning/reflection loops)
* Develop reusable agent templates, blueprints, and context frameworks to accelerate deployment across Commercial Excellence use cases
* Evaluate solution design trade-offs across business value, data readiness, model performance, and cost
* Drive the development of PoCs, MVPs, and production-grade solutions, ensuring smooth transition from experimentation to scaled deployment
* Determine optimal use of LLMs vs traditional ML / rules-based approaches based on use case requirements
* Model Lifecycle, Quality, Cost & Risk Management
* Establish and govern MLOps / LLMOps frameworks, including model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
* Define and implement CI/CD pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and retraining workflows
* Optimize key components such as retrieval strategies, embeddings, prompting, grounding, and caching
* Drive improvements in model accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost efficiency, while minimizing hallucinations
* Implement frameworks for model evaluation, explainability, and robustness
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in consulting, analytics, AI/ML, or product-led environments, ideally with exposure to Commercial Excellence / Revenue Growth / Pricing domains
* Proven experience building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions in real world applications
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
* Experience developing LLM-based applications, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Insight generation and summarization; Conversational interface
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and ML/AI libraries (e.g., Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch)
* Experience with API development (FastAPI/Flask) and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Understanding of multi-agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, and planning paradigms
* Familiarity with data pipelines, model deployment, and productizing considerations
* Strong understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, APIs, and cloud-native architectures
* Experience with foundational models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock)
* Proven experience delivering AI-powered SaaS or internal platforms to automate workflows and enhance customer experience
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align AI strategy with enterprise goals
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with adaptability to the rapidly evolving AI landscap
* Commercial Excellence & Business Acumen - Strong understanding of Commercial Excellence concepts, including, but not limited to: Pricing and margin optimization; Customer segmentation and churn; Revenue analytics and growth strategy; Salesforce effectiveness; Ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions
* Experience in data-driven problem solving and executive storytelling
* Experience working with senior stakeholders to shape commercial strategy and drive adoption, including leading workshops, influencing decision-making, and aligning cross functional teams (sales, finance, product)
* Ability to develop clear, compelling executive storylines, distilling complex analyses and AI outputs into concise recommendations for C-suite audiences
* Support managers and senior team members in delivering AI-enabled Commercial Excellence projects across product development, PoCs, demos, and client delivery
* Take ownership of defined work modules, including analysis, data preparation, model testing, workflow configuration, documentation, and output quality checks
* Work comfortably in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, showing curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new AI tools and commercial concepts
* Communicate progress, issues, and findings clearly to internal teams; proactively escalate risks or dependencies where required

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Product Management Intern
description:
**About DeHaat**

DeHaat is one of India’s fastest-growing agri-tech companies and one of very few that serve farmers end to end, from seeds to market. Its platform covers soil testing, agri-inputs, cropadvisory, farm intelligence, credit and insurance, and selling the harvest to institutional buyers. Across 12+ agrarian states, DeHaat serves 5 M+ farmers through a network of 15,000+ DeHaat Centers and 500+ FPOs.

**The role**

This is not a shadowing internship, you’ll own a real problem end to end: understanding users, writing specs, working with engineering and design, shipping, and measuring impact.

**What you’ll do**

* Talk to farmers, DeHaat Center partners, internal users. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Prototype and test AI-led experiences.
* Write PRDs and user stories for features across the farmer app, the partner app, and internal tools.
* Define success metrics, build dashboards, and run analysis on funnels, cohorts, and retention.
* Design and run experiments, including A/B tests, push and engagement campaigns, and pilots with DeHaat Centers.
* Work with engineering, design, data science, business, and on-ground teams to get features shipped.

**What we’re looking for**

* Final-year or pre-final-year student (or recent graduate) from IIT / NIT / IIIT.
* Strong first-principles thinking. You can break a messy problem down without waiting for a framework.
* Comfortable with data.
* You use AI tools daily to research, prototype, analyze, and build, and you can show us something you’ve made with them.
* Curiosity about Bharat. You want to build for users very different from yourself.

**Good to have**

* A side project, hackathon entry, or product teardown you’re proud of
* Prior internship in product, analytics, or a startup
* Exposure to LLM APIs, no-code tools (n8n, Zapier, lovable, emergent)

**What you’ll get**

* Real ownership of a shipped feature used by lakhs of farmers
* Field exposure to rural India that few product roles offer

An engagement owner for process reinvention. You take a large, complex enterprise process and redesign it as an agentic, AI-first process — from as-is diagnosis through agent architecture to realised value — and run delivery and the client relationship.
