title: Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Sprinklr is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation to lead the transformation of our Support organization through Artificial Intelligence.
  
  
This leader will define and execute the long-term AI strategy for Support, serving as the key connection point between Support, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities where AI can improve customer outcomes, increase operational efficiency, enhance employee productivity, and drive scalable growth across the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in Support Operations, Product Strategy, AI-enabled transformation, and executive stakeholder management. They are equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy, influencing product roadmaps, building governance frameworks, and driving organizational adoption of innovative technologies.
  
  
This is a highly visible leadership role with direct accountability for the vision, roadmap, governance, adoption, and measurable business impact of AI initiatives across Support.
  
  
AI Strategy & Vision
  
  

* Define and maintain a multi-year AI strategy and roadmap for the Support organization.
* Identify emerging AI technologies and assess their potential impact on customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Develop investment and prioritization frameworks to ensure focus on the highest-value opportunities.
* Establish a long-term vision for AI-powered support capabilities, including intelligent automation, agent assistance, self-service,knowledge intelligence, and autonomous support solutions.

Product & Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business Operations teams to influence priorities and accelerate AI innovation.
* Translate support challenges and opportunities into scalable AI-powered solutions.
* Serve as an executive-level advocate for Support requirements within broader company AI initiatives.
* Drive alignment between Support's strategic objectives and enterprise AI investments.

Program Execution & Transformation
  
  

* Own the Support AI portfolio and ensure strategic initiatives are executed successfully.
* Define business requirements, success criteria, adoption strategies, and operational readiness plans.
* Lead change management efforts to drive organizational adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows.
* Establish repeatable processes for evaluating, piloting, and scaling AI solutions.

Measurement & Business Outcomes
  
  

* Define KPIs and success metrics to measure AI effectiveness and organizational impact.
* Develop executive dashboards and reporting frameworks to communicate progress and outcomes.
* Track business value through improvements in productivity, customer satisfaction, case resolution efficiency, quality, and cost-to-serve.
* Build ROI models and investment analyses for AI initiatives.

Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Establish governance frameworks that balance innovation, risk management, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
* Partner with Legal, Security, Compliance, and Product teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational standards.
* Develop policies and best practices for AI deployment, measurement, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Support Operations, Product Management, Customer Experience, Business Transformation, AI Strategy, or related leadership functions.
* 5+ years leading cross-functional programs or product initiatives at scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining and executing AI, automation, or digital transformation strategies.
* Strong understanding of customer support operating models, workflows, metrics, and technologies.
* Experience developing business cases, investment strategies, ROI frameworks, and executive-level reporting.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within SaaS, customer support, customer experience, or enterprise software environments.
* Background in Product Management, AI/ML initiatives, Customer Support leadership, or Operations Strategy.
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions such as:
* Agent Assist
* Generative AI
* Conversational AI
* Intelligent Case Routing
* Knowledge Intelligence
* Workflow Automation
* Digital Self-Service
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.
* MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Consumer Science Product Intelligence - Senior Scientist
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Consumer Science and Product Intelligence (CSPI) Wellness India Senior Scientist role is a strategic and operational role that ensures we put the Consumer First, Always in everything we do. The role leads consumer science and product intelligence for the Wellness portfolio in India, partnering across R&D, Category, Innovation and Commercial teams to develop, deliver and review innovations and in-market products so they win with consumers at the point of purchase and throughout the usage experience, delivering meaningful and noticeable superiority.
  
  
Critical elements of the role are:
  
  

* Provide insights and evidence that enable consumer-led Wellness innovations that deliver meaningful and noticeable superiority.
* Champion the “Consumer First, Always” approach for Wellness India from early insight and prototype development through claims support, launch and post-launch review.
* Lead consumer and product intelligence for Wellness India to guide product, portfolio, claims, communication and renovation decisions.
* Build a clear understanding of the India Wellness landscape, including competitors, product performance, consumer reviews, complaints, claims evidence and emerging format trends.
* Translate global category strategies into locally relevant India execution, while using local insights to influence global innovation decisions.
* Bring actionable local consumer and product insights to Category teams and wider R&D, partnering with CBIA where appropriate.
* Drive faster, better innovation using ideal product models and evidence-based product narratives through the stage-gate process.
* Ensure consumer testing in India is compliant, fit for purpose and aligned with agreed work processes.
* Partner with Category, Innovation, Commercial, R&D and Medical & Scientific Affairs to focus CSPI resources on high-impact opportunities and develop consumer-relevant claims, demos, visualisations and communications.
* Use evidence to support prioritisation and deploy Wellness India CSPI resources where they can most improve consumer choice, usage and repeat purchase.

**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
E2E Consumer Science for Wellness India
  
  

* Select and apply fit-for-purpose consumer science, product research and sensory methods according to each project’s decision, risk and value.
* Deliver consumer and product evidence to identify superiority, guide product design, support claims, and create compelling product stories and visualisations versus competition
* Develop and apply leading-edge testing methods, including AI- and digitally enabled tools, to improve decision speed and deliver noticeable, meaningful product superiority.
* Lead end-to-end consumer evidence delivery from early need definition and prototype learning through formulation lock, launch and post-launch optimisation.
* Validate non-clinical claims with consumers using robust qualitative and quantitative research.
* Conduct post-launch reviews, monitor complaints and use insights to improve India Wellness products.
* Track emerging trends through social listening, market signals and product intelligence to guide pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Integrated Product Experience and Insight Generation
  
  

* Integrate consumer research, product performance, complaints, reviews, commercial signals and competitor benchmarking into unified product intelligence that guides India Wellness decisions.
* Build understanding of what drives trial, usage, repeat purchase and priority product formats in India.
* Identify consumer jobs to be done, usage occasions and unmet needs with Category CSPI to inform superior product design.
* Partner with Sensory Scientists to integrate sensory-panel and consumer evidence into clear product-design decisions.

Product Intelligence
  
  

* Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the India Wellness product landscape in partnership with Category CSPI.
* Lead product benchmarking to identify where Haleon products are superior, at parity or exposed versus competitors.
* Translate benchmarking into recommendations on where to renovate, defend, premiumise, simplify or avoid over-investment.
* Identify product and experience gaps that could improve consumer choice, usage, repeat purchase and business outcomes.

Capability, Governance and Collaboration
  
  

* Build and share Consumer Science & Product Intelligence best practices and capabilities.
* Champion consumer closeness and coach R&D colleagues outside CSPI in consumer-led decision making.
* Ensure consumer interactions comply with the Human Subject Testing Policy and all quality and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate directly with R&D, CBIA and Marketing teams to deliver decisions effectively in a matrixed environment.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* BSc degree or equivalent in an appropriate subject.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience, preferably within FMCG/CPG or Healthcare.
* Appropriate specialisations include Chemistry, Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Physics, Mathematics, Sensory Science, Food Science, Biochemistry or Biological Science.
* Preferred: MSc degree in an appropriate scientific discipline. Essential Capabilities
* Broad experience across consumer science, product research, sensory/product experience, claims evidence and product intelligence, with the ability to select fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Connect consumer science and product intelligence to clear business outcomes and growth.
* Lead through cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex priorities and evidence into simple, practical recommendations.
* Shape product, portfolio, claims and communication decisions with strong evidence and judgement.
* Apply commercial judgement and integrate multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights.
* Develop and embed novel methodologies that deliver business impact.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, strategic, communication and change-leadership skills.
* Experience across qualitative and quantitative research, consumer modelling, consumer need definition, product validation and claims substantiation.
* Commercially savvy, entrepreneurial and collaborative, with experience independently leading research programmes and solving problems in a matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Ability to problem solve
* Scientific expertise
* Project management experience
* Experience analyzing data
* Ability to influence others

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-14
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Program Management Senior Specialist - Growth Lab - Email
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. They are well organized project managers, excellent communicators, proactive problem solvers and technical subject matter experts well versed in growth marketing. They are the connective tissue between the business (product marketing managers), production project managers and development team. They ensure projects are well defined, and delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Partner with product marketing managers (PMMs) in campaign ideation and intake document formulation

+ Collaborate with PMMs during the campaign ideation stage, gather technical requirements, confirm feasibility of ideated campaign features, define potential execution timeline and the intricacies of email personalization and complex logic.
+ Provide strategic input on growth best practices, segmentation, and user journey optimization to help achieve campaign business goals.
+ Act as a consultative partner, advising PMMs on how to translate business objectives into effective owned channel (i.e. email) strategies.
+ Guide the PMM through the Campaign Requirement Document creation, ensure the intake documents are completed and comprehensive for the production team.

* Project manage campaign development and deployment

+ Kick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines.
+ Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.
+ Coordinate with Data Specialists to ensure that data requirements and inputs are fully aligned with HTML development and production process, as well as be a strategic partner between Data Specialists and offshore production team.
+ Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMM
+ Communicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.
+ Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions.

* Manage campaign deployment in Internal Growth tools, monitor campaign health

+ Actively manage the Internal growth tool (i.e..Gamma) campaign deployments and proactively manage the campaign lifecycle (pause, activate, launch Gamma campaigns). GAMMA is Google’s internal email marketing platform.
+ Be the expert on Gamma campaigns under their management.
+ Monitor campaign deployment health through Gamma reporting tools and internal tools. Where applicable, delegate monitoring to Data Specialists and email specialists acting as the accountable party for campaign health monitoring and error escalation.
+ Conduct post-launch campaign performance analysis to derive engagement insights and identify areas for future improvement.

* Troubleshoot and solve escalations

+ When issues arise on existing or newly deployed campaigns, proactively lead the resolution process by quickly identifying root causes, work closely with product marketing managers, production project managers, and the development team.
+ Document the issue in the form of a blameless post mortem, ensure alignment across stakeholders and facilitate process adjustments mitigating repetition of the issue in the future across the team.

* Keep things organized

+ Attend regular scrums and stand ups, provide updates on project status and act as a collaborative business partner to the PMM leading the scrum.
+ Effectively and proficiently communicate with the offshore production team by setting up and leading weekly calls. Maintain internal project status trackers and post launch quality control sheets.
+ Ensure accurate work progress tracking in Asana.

* Drive innovation and thrive for excellence
* Proactively look for ways to improve the process to drive efficiency and reduce risk such as through implementing AI tools in the email creative or production processes.

**Qualifications**
****Minimum Qualifications:****

* Overall 5+ years of experience in project management roles, coordinating projects across multiple organizations/cross functional teams.
* Complex Email Campaign Management: 2-3 years of proven ability to manage high-complexity, interdependent email campaigns, anticipating risks across multiple systems and stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment.
* Email Marketing Technology Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in primary email marketing technology tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Hubspot etc.) with the ability to learn and navigate independently across multiple platforms.
* Technical Proficiency (HTML): Basic understanding of web development, HTML/CSS & QA processes, with the ability to identify root causes, troubleshoot technical issues, and architect resilient solutions."
* Strategic Client Handling: Advanced client handling skills with a track record of acting as a strategic advisor, understanding scope and providing estimates that align with long-term business goals.
* Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools to interpret performance results and recommend strategic improvements to stakeholders.
* Communication: Strong, polished, and professional communication skills required for interacting with stakeholders and leading the production team.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Understanding of marketing operations, processes, business requirements.
* Proactive and curious attitude, strong problem solving skills.
* Familiarity using GenAI (generative AI) for email marketing content, production and optimization.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with rapidly changing priorities and a high volume of projects.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!

title: SPL – EdTech and AI (OBF)
description:
**About The Job SPL EdTech And AI (OBF)**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF)**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  

* Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.
* In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.

**About The Project**
A proposed outcomes-based financing (OBF) platform is being developed by Central Square Foundation in partnership with a selected program partner, to improve foundational literacy and numeracy outcomes in government schools. The initiative aims to build a robust, evidence-based case for personalised adaptive learning (PAL) in Grades 1–5, while creating the delivery, financing and procurement pathways required for state governments to adopt and fund effective solutions over time.
  
  
The programme is currently in its design and preparation phase. This includes defining the outcomes and payment framework, selecting states and solution providers, designing implementation and governance structures, establishing independent verification arrangements, securing implementation funding, and engaging governments early so that evidence generated through the programme can translate into long-term public-system adoption.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF) will lead CSF's programme design and government adoption work for the project. This is a build-stage role suited to someone who can create structure in ambiguity, bring together diverse stakeholders, and design a programme that is rigorous enough for outcomes-based financing while remaining feasible and relevant for government systems.
  
  
The role will work closely with state governments, EdTech solution providers, funders, program partners, independent evaluators and internal CSF teams. A core mandate will be to ensure that government adoption is not treated as an end-stage activity: the Senior Project Lead will shape the programme from the outset around government priorities, implementation realities, evidence needs and eventual pathways for public financing and procurement.
  
  
The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Director/Senior Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Programme Strategy, Design & Build
* Lead the end-to-end design of the OBF project from CSF's programme and government-adoption perspective, translating the concept into a clear operating model, implementation architecture, workplan and measurable outcomes.
* Define key design choices across target grades and geographies, student reach, school-level implementation, technology and infrastructure requirements, provider roles, sequencing and scale-up pathways.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify critical assumptions, risks and trade-offs, and translate them into testable design decisions and mitigation plans.
* Ensure the programme design balances learning impact, implementation feasibility, provider incentives, evidence requirements, cost-effectiveness and relevance to government systems.
* Outcomes-Based Financing & Performance Framework
* Work closely with a selected program partner, funders, providers and evaluators to shape an outcomes-based financing model that is credible, implementable and aligned to the programme's learning objectives.
* Contribute to the definition of outcome metrics and payment milestones across onboarding/readiness, product usage and learning gains, including thresholds, verification approaches and implications for provider incentives.
* Support the development of templates and approaches that can inform future outcomes-linked government procurement for PAL.
* Government Engagement, Salience & Adoption Pathway
* Lead early government engagement so that programme design reflects state priorities, FLN strategies, infrastructure constraints, implementation capacity and decision-making processes.
* Develop a deliberate government salience strategy: identify the evidence, experiences, champions, review forums and decision points required for PAL to become a credible part of the state's FLN agenda in the long term.
* Create a pathway from philanthropic financing to sustained government ownership, including potential budget heads, procurement models, institutional roles and transition milestones.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs such as concept notes, briefs, implementation frameworks, review materials and procurement-oriented documentation.
* Multi-Stakeholder Partnership & Programme Governance
* Serve as a key integrator across state governments, solution providers, selected program partner funders, independent evaluators and CSF teams, ensuring clarity of roles, dependencies and decision rights.
* Lead programme governance processes including workplans, design reviews, decision logs, risk registers, partner reviews and senior stakeholder updates.
* Anticipate and resolve cross-stakeholder bottlenecks while protecting the integrity of the programme's learning and adoption objectives.
* Implementation Readiness, Evidence & Learning
* Co-develop the learning agenda and define the conditions for PAL to deliver outcomes at scale in government primary schools, including implementation fidelity, cost, provider performance and system integration
* Work with Evidence/M&E teams and independent evaluators to ensure that the evaluation and verification framework answers both payment-related questions and the broader questions governments will need answered before adoption.
* Use implementation data and field insights to diagnose bottlenecks, drive course correction and strengthen the programme model over time.
* Knowledge, Scale Strategy & Institutionalisation
* Translate programme evidence and implementation learning into a compelling case for state adoption of PAL in primary grades.
* Develop practical public goods such as implementation playbooks, adoption frameworks, procurement templates, cost models, case studies and policy notes that can support replication beyond participating states.
* Contribute to CSF's broader thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, outcomes-based financing and sustainable public financing for technology-enabled learning.
* Team, Budget & Organisational Leadership
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own CSF-side programme planning, budgeting, resourcing, reporting and leadership decision materials for the OBF project.
* Coordinate closely with CSF's EdTech and AI, Evidence, State Reform, Finance, Legal, Communications and other relevant teams.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent sectors.
* Exposure to outcomes-based financing, results-based financing, impact bonds, performance-linked contracts or innovative procurement models
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customized to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words), and two references through the CSF Careers Portal by
**30th September 2026**
.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can commit to at least a three-year journey to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy. Shortlisted applicants will complete a case exercise and participate in 2 panel interviews and final leadership conversations. We will evaluate applications on a rolling basis and will close the application process once we find the right candidate.

description: This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India. About EAIIEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAIIAbout Evidence ActionAt Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains. Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children. Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives. At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.The RoleOur Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture-style, stage-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.ResponsibilitiesOwn a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerator's stage-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipelineInterrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each intervention's evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps. Model impact and cost-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost-Effectiveness team to build and pressure-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no-go implicationsDesign and run decision-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisionsBuild the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentumCollaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we workBe Evidence Action's face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnershipsStrengthen the Accelerator's methods, AI-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you leadRequirementsEssentialYou have a bachelors degree and 6 - 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross-country settingYou read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not supportYou build or rigorously interpret cost-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertaintyYou design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timelineYou move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect informationYou build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared pathYou make complex technical findings clear and decision-useful for non-technical audiences, in writing and liveYou manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce timeYou have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teamsYou look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own workDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.Position LocationThe role is based in New Delhi, India.We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.BenefitsEAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisionsLife and Accidental insurancePF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirementsMental and physical well-being benefitsLearning and Development benefitGenerous leaveAvenues for engagement and recognitionCompensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.All candidates applying for the position should upload a resume along with cover letter mentioning current and expected salary.

title: Senior Product Manager
description: Title: Product Manager / Senior Product ManagerLocation: Gurugram, India (on-site) · Experience: 2–8 yearsAbout INDmoneyINDmoney is a personal finance super app that helps millions of Indians track, invest and grow their money in one place. Users invest in US stocks, Indian stocks, mutual funds, IPOs and fixed deposits, and manage credit cards, loans and net worth from a single app.About the roleEvery day, thousands of users tell us what’s broken — through support tickets, app reviews, call transcripts, chatbot logs and drop-off data. Most companies route these to a backlog. We want one person who owns them end to end.You’ll pick up a consumer problem, find out why it’s happening, and ship the fix — whatever shape the fix takes. Some days that’s a one-line change to an order status screen. Some days it’s a new state in a backend workflow, a rewrite of a help-centre article, a new macro or lookup tool for our support reps, or a process change with Ops and Compliance. You decide what the right fix is, get it built (or build it), and verify the problem actually went away.You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Operations and Compliance, and report directly to product leadership. Your scorecard is simple: fewer tickets, faster resolutions, fewer users stuck.What you’ll doMine CRM tickets, call recordings, chatbot transcripts, Play Store/App Store reviews and product analytics funnels to find the problems worth solving, and size them.Run root-cause analysis: trace a user complaint back through app state, API responses, backend workflows and ops processes to the actual failure point.Spec and ship fixes across the full stack of the problem: frontend copy and UI states, backend status handling, retry/edge-case logic, ops workflows, help-centre content and internal tools for CS reps.Write clear, plain-language user-facing copy for error states, status screens and help articles.Build or improve tools for the support team: dashboards, lookup views, canned responses, escalation flows.Close the loop: instrument fixes, watch ticket volumes and funnels, and confirm the problem is gone before moving on.Flag patterns upstream — if the same class of issue keeps recurring, drive the structural fix with the relevant product or engineering owner.What we’re looking for2–8 years in product, operations, support engineering, solutions engineering or a similar role where you owned problems end to end.Comfortable with SQL; you can pull your own data from a warehouse without waiting on anyone.Strong systems thinking: you can read an API response, follow a state machine, and reason about why a payment, order or KYC step got stuck.Able to write a crisp spec and a crisp help article — and know which one the problem needs.Evidence of shipping: you can point to things you fixed and the metric that moved.High ownership and low ego. You’d rather solve the problem than argue about whose problem it is.Nice to haveExperience at a broker, fintech or consumer app in India — familiarity with SEBI/RBI flows (KYC, DDPI, settlements, pay-in/pay-out, corporate actions) is a plus.Can read code or write basic scripts (Python/JS) to prototype a tool or debug a flow.Hands-on with CRM/ticketing, issue-tracking and product analytics tools.Experience building internal tools or agent-facing workflows.Exposure to LLM/chatbot tooling for support automation.Why joinReal impact, fast. Your fixes will reach millions of investors and show up in ticket volumes within weeks.Ownership. You own the problem from complaint to resolution, with direct access to the founders and senior leadership.Growth. Competitive compensation with ESOPs, a learning budget and a team that ships every week.Breadth. You’ll touch product, engineering, ops, compliance and support in a single role — a rare vantage point on how a fintech actually runs.Visibility. The problems you solve are the ones leadership hears about most. Good work here is seen.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About ixigo**
:

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Flights Product Strategy:**
  Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* **Post-Booking Experience:**
  Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* **Booking Funnel Optimization:**
  Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* **Partner Onboarding & Distribution:**
  Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* **Continuous Experimentation:**
  Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* **Data-Driven Optimization:**
  Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

**Qualifications:**

* **4-6 years of experience in Product Management,**
  ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* **Funnel & Growth Mindset:**
  Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* **User-Centric Mindset:**
  An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* **Technical Fluency:**
  Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* **Execution Excellence:**
  Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* **OTA Experience:**
  Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* **Partnership & Integration Acumen:**
  Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* **AI/ML Exposure:**
  Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* **Growth Mindset:**
  A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

Additional Information: Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Product Owner - AI Native Products
description:
***Product Owner***

Incedo is a US-based consulting, data science and technology services firm with over 2,500 people helping clients from our six offices across US and India. We help our clients achieve competitive advantage through end-to-end digital transformation. Our uniqueness lies in bringing together strong engineering, data science, and design capabilities coupled with deep domain understanding. We combine services and products to maximize business impact for our clients in telecom, financial services, product engineering and life science & healthcare industries.

Working at Incedo will provide you an opportunity to work with industry leading client organizations, deep technology and domain experts, and global teams. Incedo University, our learning platform, provides ample learning opportunities starting with a structured onboarding program and carrying throughout various stages of your career. A variety of fun activities are also an integral part of our friendly work environment. Our flexible career paths allow you to grow into a product manager, a domain expert, client engagement manager based on your skills and interests.

**Role Description:**

The Product Owner plays a pivotal role in shaping product strategy, defining features, managing requirements, and ensuring successful delivery. This role demands a strong blend of
**user-centric thinking, analytical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and client engagement**
. You will partner with engineering, design, sales, and analytics teams to bring digital products to life.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Definition & Strategy**

* Understand market trends, user needs, and business goals to contribute to the product vision and roadmap.
* Translate business problems and user pain points into well-scoped product opportunities
* Conduct competitive analysis and benchmark features across comparable products.

**Feature Prioritisation & Roadmapping**

* Prioritise features using relevant frameworks and evaluate trade-offs.
* Manage the product backlog and ensure alignment between product strategy and execution.
* Collaborate with leadership to refine quarterly and sprint-level priorities.

**Requirements Gathering & Specification**

* Engage with clients, internal stakeholders, and end users to gather functional and technical requirements.
* Write clear and detailed
  **PRDs**
  ,
  **user stories**
  , use cases, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams.
* Ensure requirements are aligned with user needs, business value, and technical feasibility.
* **Client Interaction & Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary product liaison for client teams, understanding their needs and aligning expectations.
* Communicate progress, trade-offs, and product decisions clearly and confidently.
* Build trusted relationships and proactively identify product enhancements or new use cases.

title: Product Manager (Flights- Supply)
description:
Role: Product Manager
  
  
Location: Gurgaon
  
  
**About The Function**
Flights is MakeMyTrip’s flagship business, serving millions of travellers across domestic and international routes. Within it, Flights Supply is the engine behind every fare a customer sees, books and gets serviced on. It covers connectivity with airlines, GDS, NDC and aggregators, and the content, pricing and servicing capabilities built on top.
  
  
As the business scales, the supply stack must be more reliable, more accurate and less dependent on manual effort. We are building supply systems that detect problems before customers do, keep content and pricing in parity with the source, and use AI to automate work that has traditionally been manual.
  
  
The Flights Supply team combines deep distribution knowledge, data-driven decision making and strong engineering partnerships. Product managers, analysts, engineers, designers and business teams work together to make every booking dependable and every servicing journey efficient.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Deputy Manager, Product Management to own a workstream within Flights Supply, such as supply-side conversion, content and pricing accuracy, or airline and ancillary integrations. This role requires strong product thinking, a quick grasp of technical systems, execution excellence and a passion for solving problems with data and AI.
  
  
You will take features and projects from problem definition to launch, working closely with engineering, airline and distribution partners, finance, customer support and the funnel product team. You will shape the direction of your workstream and be accountable for its results.
  
  
What will you be doing
  
  

* Define the vision, roadmap and priorities for your workstream within Flights Supply, and drive it end to end in line with the overall supply strategy.
* Work with engineering on GDS, NDC, LCC and aggregator integrations. Understand how fares, availability and ticketing flow, find where they break, and drive fixes and monitoring.
* Identify high-impact supply problems, such as price mismatch, fare unavailability, content gaps and recurring escalations, and turn them into clear, well-scoped product opportunities.
* Drive ancillary and content coverage across suppliers and airlines, and improve content parity (fare rules, baggage, ancillaries) against source and competitors.
* Improve pricing and fare-loading tooling, and reduce manual dependency in content refresh and QC.
* Use AI to catch problems earlier and cut manual effort: detect fare and content anomalies, classify and root-cause escalations, and convert unstructured airline inputs (fare rules, schedule-change notices, airline circulars) into structured data the system can act on.
* Run onboarding of new airlines and NDC/API partners, from requirements through testing to go-live.
* Define hypotheses, success metrics and measurement for every initiative you own.
* Track product KPIs, build dashboards, and keep improving performance through data analysis and stakeholder feedback.
* Write detailed specs and groom stories in depth with tech, so edge cases are caught before development, not after go-live.
* Run execution from concept to launch and post-launch optimisation, and flag risks and delays early.

**You Will Operate At The Intersection Of**
Supply Technology + Distribution + Data Science + AI-powered Automation Platform Reliability + Conversion + Cost Efficiency Partner and Customer Understanding + Data-Driven Decision Making
  
  
You will identify high-impact opportunities, validate solutions quickly, and ship products that create measurable value for customers and the business.
  
  
Qualification & Experience
  
  

* Engineering or Management graduates from reputed institutes with years 4-6 years of experience in product management roles for consumer-facing or technology-enabled businesses.
* Experience managing the product lifecycle using agile methodologies, including requirement definition, prioritisation and metric tracking.
* Experience working with complex datasets using analytical tools and techniques. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and SQL is expected.
* Exposure to flights, OTA, airline or travel-distribution products, including GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), NDC, LCC and aggregator models, will be an added advantage.
* Prior experience with dashboards and product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or Mixpanel will be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with the Indian travel market and its seasonality is a plus.

Key Success Factors for the Role
  
  

* Strong product thinking, with the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into structured product solutions.
* Ability to learn flight distribution quickly, and to understand how technical decisions influence reliability, cost and scalability.
* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to work with large datasets, sanity-check your own outputs and deliver insights and recommendations, not just numbers.
* Curiosity about ML and GenAI and their application to supply operations.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across business, engineering, analytics, finance and partner teams.
* High ownership mindset, with the ability to drive work independently from ideation to execution, communicate proactively and deliver on time.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from ideation to execution.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**
Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Have**
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
**The Role**
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:

+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
+ Embedding generation and optimization
+ Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:

+ Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
+ Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:

+ Hallucination rate and factual consistency
+ Relevance and precision/recall
+ Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
+ Cost tracking and efficiency

* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.
