In this role, you will be responsible for building seamless checkout experiences, integrating payment gateways (PGs), optimizing transaction routing, and leading consumer/merchant payment flows across UPI, cards, netbanking, mandates and alternative payment methods. You will act as the bridge between engineering, design, risk, compliance, and partner banks/aggregators to drive higher transaction success rates, reduce checkout friction, and maintain strict adherence to regulatory standards (NPCI/RBI). Key Responsibilities Checkout & PG Integrations: Own the end-to-end checkout funnel. Design, integrate, and optimize payment gateways, aggregators, routing engines, and tokenization solutions to lower latency and increase Payment Success Rates (PSR). • Payment journeys: product initiatives across payment stacks: UPI(Intent, Collect, QR, AutoPay, Credit on UPI), Cards – Debit & credit, Netbanking, Wallets and BNPL Product Discovery & Execution: Define the payment strategy, prioritize the product backlog, and write clear, engineering-ready PRDs with explicit technical acceptance criteria and edge-case handling logic. Conversion Optimization & Funnel Analysis: Use analytical tools (SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude) to identify drop-off points, design A/B tests, and optimize payment recovery flows (e.g., auto-retry mechanisms, dynamic fallback options). Reconciliation & Settlement Operations: Collaborate with finance and operations to build reliable automated reconciliation, refund, payout, and chargeback/dispute resolution workflows. Regulatory Compliance & Security: Maintain strict compliance with RBI, NPCI, PCI-DSS guidelines, and PA/PG regulatory frameworks from initial spec to production rollout. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Risk & Fraud, Legal, and Bank/Partner Integration teams to deliver features on schedule. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on Product Management experience within Fintech, Digital Payments, or E-commerce. Domain Mastery: Proven experience with PG/PA integrations, checkout funnel optimization, UPI infrastructure (P2P/P2M, AutoPay) Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to read API documentation, map sequence diagrams, understand webhook architectures, and collaborate closely with backend/infrastructure engineers. Data-Driven Mindset: Hands-on experience analyzing funnel metrics, building reports via SQL or BI tools, and conducting hypothesis-driven experimentation. Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem, including NPCI circulars, RBI payment guidelines, and tokenization mandates. Execution Excellence: Track record of taking complex 0-to-1 or 1-to-10 payment products from concept to launch in fast-paced environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with merchant onboarding/activation flows or developer-facing APIs/SDKs. Hands-on familiarity with fraud mitigation tools, risk engines, or AI-assisted product development workflows.

title: Senior Product Manager - Content
description:
**Senior Product Manager – Content**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Team:**
Product – Content

**Level:**
Senior Product Manager

**Company Overview**

Nykaa is an omnichannel beauty and lifestyle destination, bringing together commerce, content, and technology to help customers discover products and make informed purchase decisions.

**Role Overview**

As Senior Product Manager – Content, you will own the product roadmap and execution for Nykaa’s Content and Affiliate ecosystem and content experiences across our platforms

You will build experiences that connect creator influence and content discovery to commerce, grow adoption, and demonstrate incremental sales and cost efficiency. The role combines strategic thinking, hands-on delivery, and strong business alignment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Own the Content Product Charter**

* Lead quarterly planning, prioritization, and delivery across the charter. Develop a clear point of view on new opportunities and the existing backlog, grounded in customer problems and measurable outcomes.
* Contribute to annual planning through industry comparisons, growth proposals, and evidence-backed investment cases
* Define success metrics and measure how content contributes to customer engagement, conversion, and business growth

**2. Build Content Discovery and Creator Experiences**

* Improve content experiences across the shopping journey, helping customers discover the right products for their needs
* Build capabilities for creator activation, growth & retention. Balance creator value with sustainable program economics

**3. Drive Execution and Adoption**

* Work closely with technology & business teams to deliver products that solve customer and creator needs
* Partner with business teams to drive adoption of the capabilities, both across customer platforms and affiliate platforms

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven product management experience in consumer internet or e-commerce, with ownership of complex products from discovery through launch and measurement.
* Strong analytical judgment across engagement, conversion, attribution, experimentation, and business economics.
* Ability to shape a quarterly roadmap while staying closely involved in day-to-day execution.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to align business and technology teams around priorities and outcomes.
* Ability to understand unfamiliar domains quickly and turn industry insights into practical product decisions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with content platforms, creator ecosystems, social commerce, or growth products
* Familiarity with beauty and lifestyle consumer behaviour

**Why Join Us**

Shape how content and creators influence shopping at Nykaa. This role offers ownership across consumer and creator experiences, with a direct opportunity to connect product innovation to measurable business growth.

DentalKart is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own and scale AI-first product initiatives — from 0-to-1 builds to optimizing existing GenAI-powered workflows. title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.

description:
**Role: NPD (New Product Development) Lead –** 
 Product \& Design  
 



**Team:** 
 New Product Development 
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Founder 
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Hybrid) 
 



  
 



  





**About Nurturing Green** 
  
 



  





 Nurturing Green is India's leading gardening lifestyle brand, making plants and gardening products accessible to millions of customers through Retail, E\-commerce and Quick Commerce. 
 



  





 Featured on
 **Shark Tank India Season 4** 
 , we are present across Amazon, Flipkart, Blink it, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket, Myntra and multiple offline retail formats, with an aggressive vision to become India's most loved gardening brand. 
 



  





 We believe great products are born where design, functionality, and storytelling come together. We're looking for a design\-first creative leader who can shape the next generation of Nurturing Green products and create collections that customers love. 
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 
  
 



  
 


* We are looking for an
 **NPD Lead** 
 who combines strong creative thinking with hands\-on product development, category knowledge and execution capabilities.
* The role will own the product journey from
 **concept to sampling, refinement, costing, packaging, production readiness and launch** 
 , while also driving the visual communication of products across catalogues, e\-commerce and marketing touchpoints.
* Working closely with the Founder, Product/Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales and Marketing teams, the NPD Lead will ensure products are creatively strong, commercially viable and operationally ready for scale.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



  





**1\. Product Development \& NPD** 
  
 


* Identify new product opportunities through consumer insights, market trends, category gaps and business requirements.
* Translate ideas and trends into commercially relevant product concepts and collections.
* Develop concepts, sketches, mood boards, specifications, prototypes and samples.
* Build cohesive collections across plants, planters, home décor, gifting, lifestyle and related categories.
* Own the NPD process from
 **concept → sourcing → sampling → iteration → costing → final approval → production readiness → launch** 
 .
* Maintain product specifications, BOMs, dimensions, material details and NPD documentation.
* Manage sampling cycles and resolve design, functionality, quality and production issues.



  





**2\. Category, Material \& Manufacturing Knowledge** 
  
 


* Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories, materials and manufacturing processes.
* Evaluate materials, construction methods, finishes and production techniques based on design, cost and feasibility.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to identify practical and commercially viable solutions.



  





**3\. Vendor, Sourcing \& Cross\-functional Coordination** 
  
 


* Work closely with Purchase, Merchandising and vendors throughout the development cycle.
* Brief vendors on product concepts, specifications, materials, finishes and packaging requirements.
* Evaluate samples and drive revisions until products meet the required design and quality standards.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Warehouse, Sales,and Operations to ensure smooth product development and launch.
* Proactively manage timelines, dependencies, and development challenges.



  
 



**4\. Packaging Design \& Product Communication** 
  
 


* Lead the design and development of
 **product packaging, labels, inserts, tags, sleeves, boxes and other product communication elements** 
 .
* Ensure packaging balances
 **brand presentation, functionality, product protection, cost and production feasibility** 
 .
* Lead or guide the development of
 **product catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives, Quick Commerce creatives and marketing graphics** 
 for new products and collections.
* Ensure product features, specifications, USPs and visual communication are accurate and consistent across customer\-facing touchpoints.



  
 



  





**5\. Team Management** 
  
 


* Lead and mentor Junior Product Designers and other NPD resources.
* Set clear briefs, timelines, and development expectations.
* Conduct regular product and design reviews.



  





**Core Requirements** 
  
 


* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in Product Design, Product Development, NPD, Category Development, or a similar role within consumer/lifestyle brands.
* Strong experience taking products from concept through sampling and production.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, product development, and collection building.
* Hands\-on experience with vendors, manufacturers, and sampling cycles.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, construction, finishes, and product costing.
* Experience in categories such as home décor, lifestyle, gifting, ceramics, hardgoods, furniture, accessories, handicrafts, gardening products or similar consumer products.
* Good understanding of packaging design and development, including production\-ready artwork, materials,timelines, finishes, and vendor coordination.
* Experience with catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives or marketing graphics is preferred.
* Strong creative and aesthetic sensibility with the ability to translate trends into commercially relevant products.
* Ability to manage multiple NPD projects and timelines independently.
* Graduate/Postgraduate from NID, NIFT, Srishti, Pearl Academy, MIT Institute of Design or equivalent design/product development institutes preferred.
* Candidates from pure fashion/apparel design backgrounds are not preferred unless they have significant hardgoods/lifestyle product development experience.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Canva and AI\-assisted design workflows are preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 
  
 


* Develop differentiated and commercially relevant product collections.
* Move products efficiently from concept to production and launch.
* Build strong vendors and manufacturing relationships.
* Maintain high standards of product quality, design, and functionality.
* Deliver products within expected cost and timeline parameters.
* Ensure packaging and product communication effectively support the product proposition.
* Enable smooth collaboration across NPD, Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales, Marketing and Operations.
* Strengthen Nurturing Green's product portfolio through a balance of creativity, category knowledge, functionality, manufacturability and commercial viability.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 
  
 


* The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of Creative \+ Product \+ Operations.
* They should be able to identify an opportunity, understand the category, conceptualize a product, develop and sample it, work with vendors, evaluate costing and feasibility, solve production challenges, develop packaging and product communication, and coordinate internal teams through launch.
* They should be equally comfortable discussing design concepts, materials, samples, costing, packaging, specifications, vendor feasibility and launch requirements.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Camley Camley is building the agentic infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are leading private equity and infrastructure investment firms, and we are at the forefront of transforming a $55T asset class that still runs on spreadsheets and software built in the 1990s. What Harvey did for legal, we are doing for private markets. We are building the multi\-agent architecture that operates funds end\-to\-end, solving the highest\-stakes problems investment firms face with accuracy and speed. Our agents are not just chatbots \- they move money and execute workflows autonomously. We are backed by top VCs, incl. the first investor in Lovable and one of the most technical AI investors in Silicon Valley responsible for building Uber’s core algorithm. Camley is built by a team from Stanford, Harvard, IIT Delhi, and Penn, with decades of industry experience at McKinsey, SquarePoint, and Deutsche Bank \+ building foundation models for an Accel\-backed startup. About the role We are hiring a founding full\-stack AI engineer. You will build products end\-to\-end and shape agent architecture and technical decisions alongside the CTO. You’ll build the core intelligence layer \- language models for reading documents, a knowledge graph \& vector DB for storing data and relationships, a calculation engine for the fund mathematics and an orchestration layer that coordinates these into workflows that an auditor can sign. You'll own high\-impact features across the stack, from model integration to infrastructure. We are a small team working across London and New York. We are open to remote/hybrid for the right candidate. We are a lean team with a high bar for excellence, and hours will at times be intense as in any high\-growth startup. In return, you get the autonomy to do some of the best work of your life, and a founding team that values openness, empathy, and not taking ourselves too seriously. title: Senior Category Associate
description:
**About Us** 
 : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles \& modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut \& spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 A Senior Category Associate does everything a Category Associate does \- stays close to the consumer, keeps the insight engine running, keeps ops tight \- and then goes one step further: you own the category's P\&L and make the calls. Pricing, mix, promo calendar, launch bets, inventory investment \- the decisions are yours, backed by the ground\-truth you built.
 



  





**Why this stays hands\-on even once you own the P\&L** 




 It would be easy, at this level, to hand the calls and FGDs to someone junior and sit with the dashboard instead. We deliberately don't let that happen. The decisions you're now accountable for \- pricing, assortment, what to launch, what to sunset \- are only as good as the ground\-truth behind them, and that ground\-truth comes from talking to consumers directly, not from a report someone else generated.
 



  





 Secondary data tells you what happened last month. A direct conversation tells you why, early enough to act before it shows up as a dip in the number you own. The Senior Category Associates who make the best calls are the ones who never fully hand over the phone \- they just get faster and sharper at turning what they hear into a decision.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **The full Category Associate scope** 
 \- consumer insight generation (calls, FGDs, in\-person), insight\-to\-action, category ops, KPI dashboards and automation, ground\-up category mapping \- at a higher bar of independence.
2. **Category P\&L.** 
 Own revenue, margin and growth for your category end\-to\-end \- you know the number, you know why it moved, and you're accountable for moving it.
3. **Pricing and promo decisions.** 
 Set and adjust pricing, discounting and the promo calendar for your category based on consumer insight, competitive movement and margin impact.
4. **Portfolio and launch calls.** 
 Decide what's in and out of the category's assortment \- which SKUs to push, fix or sunset \- and drive new launches from consumer insight through to go\-to\-market, owning the business case.
5. **Inventory and investment.** 
 Make the call on stock investment and category spend, balancing growth against working capital.
6. **The "why" behind the plan.** 
 Brief and align Marketing, Creative, Supply and Ops around your category plan \- you're the person who owns the reasoning, not just the numbers.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You can explain your category's P\&L movement for the last quarter, cold \- and you have a point of view on what to do next.
* You've made and owned at least one real pricing, promo or assortment call, and can show the before/after.
* Your workflows and trackers run without you touching them daily \- your time is going into decisions, not data\-pulling.
* Cross\-functional teams come to you as the source of truth in your category.



  





**What you bring** 



* 2\+ years of experience, ideally with exposure to consumer research/insights and category or business ops \- a Category Associate background, or equivalent, is ideal.
* Comfortable owning a number: you think in margin, contribution and growth, not just tasks completed.
* Strong data fluency with a real bias to automate \- you build the system once so you're not rebuilding the report every week.
* A decisive, business\-first operator \- you can move from "here's the insight" to "here's the decision" to "here's what shipped."
* Still hands\-on with consumers directly \- this isn't a desk\-only role even at the senior level.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in

title: Category Associate
description:
**About Us** 
 : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles \& modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut \& spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Most entry\-level category hires start with a dashboard. This one starts with a phone call. The Category Associate's job is to build the category's understanding of its consumer from the ground up \- through call surveys, focus group discussions (FGDs) and in\-person interactions \- and turn that into insight that shapes what we make, how we sell it, and where we invest next. It's a research\-to\-execution role: you generate the insight, then help ship the decisions that follow from it.
 



  





**Why this starts with a real conversation, not a dashboard** 




 We won't pretend it's the easy part. Calling a stranger, running an FGD, or standing in front of a consumer and asking why she didn't repurchase is harder than pulling a report \- and most people this early in their career would rather stay behind a screen. We're asking you to do it anyway, because it's the one input nobody else in the building has.
 



  





 Secondary data \- sales, ratings, app analytics \- tells you
 *what* 
 happened. A consumer conversation tells you
 *why* 
 , often weeks before it shows up in a number. That gap is where category strategy actually gets built: which claim lands, which price point stings, which product idea is a real gap versus a nice\-to\-know. Skip the conversation and you're strategising on guesses.
 



  





 It's also the fastest route to real say in the business. The Category Associates who move quickest into P\&L ownership are the ones whose point of view the business trusts before the data catches up \- because they built it firsthand, one conversation at a time.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **Consumer insight engine.** 
 Run structured call surveys, FGDs and in\-person consumer interactions (store visits, pop\-ups, cohort meetups) to build a live, ground\-up read of what the category's consumer wants, buys, and drops off on \- a standing system, not a one\-time project.
2. **Insight → action.** 
 Convert raw consumer feedback into structured insight \- need\-gaps, purchase triggers, objections, usage occasions \- that Product, Marketing and Ops can act on, and follow through to make sure it actually gets used.
3. **Category ops execution.** 
 Own the operational backbone of the category \- listings, pricing hygiene, catalog accuracy, promo execution, inventory flags, competitor tracking \- so nothing slips between insight and shelf.
4. **Data and dashboards.** 
 Track category KPIs (sales, conversion, repeat rate, ratings/reviews, NPS) and build or automate the reporting for them. The bar: build a workflow once, don't rebuild a report every week.
5. **Ground\-up category mapping.** 
 Build and maintain the category's core reference material \- competitor landscape, price\-value map, consumer segments, category taxonomy \- as living, reusable assets, not one\-off decks.
6. **Cross\-functional coordination.** 
 Work daily with Marketing, Creative, Ops and Supply to get category initiatives shipped on time.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You've personally spoken to 50\+ consumers (calls, FGDs, in\-person) and turned it into one clear point of view on a real gap or opportunity in the category.
* You've built, or meaningfully improved, a self\-refreshing dashboard for the category's core KPIs \- no manual pull required.
* You know the category's competitive set cold: pricing, claims, reviews, what's winning and why.
* At least one of your insights has visibly changed a decision \- a listing, a claim, a promo, a launch input.



  





**What you bring** 



* 1\+ years of experience \- freshers welcome; internships or research/analytics projects count.
* You genuinely enjoy talking to consumers \- you'd rather run 10 calls than read 10 secondary reports.
* Strong with data: comfortable in Excel/Sheets at minimum; SQL or basic scripting is a real plus, and you're always looking for what can be automated rather than repeated by hand.
* Business\-first instinct \- you don't stop at "here's what the data says," you push to "here's what we should do about it."
* High ownership of ops execution \- as comfortable in the weeds of listings, pricing sheets and trackers as you are in a deck.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline \- research, consumer behaviour, business or a quant background all work well here.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in

 The Commercial Product Manager will own one or more product/solution and lead commercial rollout and product lifecycle in\-market. * Effectively manages day\-to\-day issues and problems without intervention.
* Generates new ideas by analyzing product data for insights.

* Outlines key milestones, outcomes and deliverables during go\-to\-market and product strategy planning.

* Has a deep understanding of product features, value proposition, customer Use Cases; able to develop User story, prototypes and test hypotheses

* Understands, formulates and budgets the operating costs required to deliver the revenues
* Creates product development plans including opportunity assessment and business case.


**Technical Skills**
* Considers high\-level technical approaches to use when prioritizing functionality.
* Is proficient with technologies and AI
* Has a firm grasp of data, technical principles and best practices of product management


**Requirements**
* Show a customer\-centric focus when creating solutions
* Minimum Years of PM Experience: 4 years
* Able to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to create, and rollout successful products to customers
* Have great experience working as a Product Lead, delivering enhancements and innovation to customers contributing to business growth
* Have excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex information to a variety of audiences
* Have a proficient background in various technologies including Microsoft suites, Power BI, data analytics tools and AI tools
* Bachelors degree in commercial discipline ( Product, Marketing, Business, Law). MBA is preferred.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Senior Product Manager is responsible for managing key partner and platform integration products within the business unit product portfolio. This role is responsible for managing inputs from external and internal stakeholders, product planning, managing platform dependencies, leading cross functional teams for release and go\-to\-market plans and activities, enhancing and differentiating product within our core markets to best position the products within our markets and the competitive landscape. Interfaces with engineering, operations and sales to develop new products and enhance existing products.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
 Be the trusted thought leader for your product area; being the ‘voice of the market/customer’ within Inovalon and externally with customer interactions and events.
   

  

 Build and maintain roadmap for products and work with cross\-functional teams to deliver a unified product plan to the market.
   

  

 Work with Marketing and Sales to define the go\-to\-market strategy, product positioning, and pricing strategies.
   

  

 Develop, drive and coordinate complex product priorities in a fast\-paced environment with intra\-team and inter\-team dependencies.
   

  

 Develop and implement a company\-wide commercialization and launch plan for the products within the product line, working with all departments and the Product PMO to execute.
   

  

 Translate product strategy into requirements and prototypes, and then work with architects, developers and customers to implement these features.
   

  

 Serve as a product evangelist with Marketing, Sales, and the go\-to\-market organization to confirm the vision, roadmap and best practices are understood.
   

  

 Analyze and manage to product metrics/KPI’s that inform the success of your products in the market.
   

  

**Work Experience**
 10\+ Years of Software Product Management experience managing platform or integration products
   

  

 5\+ Years of healthcare information technology experience with a focus on partner integration products
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Agile development methodologies
   

  

 Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) in relevant field
   

  

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H\-1B, TN, or E\-3\). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US\-based positions)*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Software Product Leadership – eCommerce (Storefront \& Analytics)** 




  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Product Leader** 
 to own and drive the evolution of Nutrabay’s eCommerce storefront and analytics ecosystem. The role will be responsible for shaping product strategy, driving cross\-functional execution, and improving the customer journey across Web, Mobile, and API platforms.
 



  





**You Should Apply If You Have:** 




 ● 5\-8 years of experience working as a Sr. Product Manager or above, ideally have worked previously with Consumer\-Facing, Large\-Scale eCommerce business.
 



 ● Have worked on or know at least 50% of the storefront and pre purchase eCommerce infrastructure modules listed below:
 


1. Affiliate Management Systems
2. Coupon Management Systems
3. Loyalty Programs
4. Referral Programs
5. MarTech Integrations
6. eCommerce Product Analytics
7. Homepage\-to\-Checkout Conversion Journey
8. Gamification \& Engagement
9. Product Search \& Discovery
10. Payment Gateway Integrations



 ● Strong analytical and data\-driven mindset, with the ability to define, track, and improve product KPIs.
 



 ● Comfortable working independently and navigating
 **fast\-paced, ambiguous, and unstructured environments** 
 .
 



 ● A fast learner who enjoys solving complex problems and picking up new skills.
 



 ● Strong communication skills with fluency in
 **English and Hindi** 
 .
 



 ● Experience working with
 **Agile product development teams** 
 .
 



  





**What Will You Do:** 




 ● Define and drive product vision and strategy across
 **Web, Mobile, and API** 
 platforms in alignment with company goals.
 



 ● Lead cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment on product goals, priorities, and execution.
 



 ● Own the product portfolio, optimizing for customer value and business KPIs.
 



 ● Identify market trends, emerging technologies, and new opportunities to shape product strategy.
 



 ● Develop and manage product roadmaps, balancing short\-term priorities with long\-term vision.
 



 ● Partner with senior leadership to align product strategy with broader business objectives.
 



 ● Establish a data\-driven approach to decision\-making and track key product metrics and KPIs.
 



 ● Lead user research initiatives to understand customer needs and validate product hypotheses.
 



 ● Analyze customer feedback and insights to drive prioritization and product improvements.
 



 ● Mentor and manage Product Managers, fostering growth and high performance.
 



 ● Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Support teams to drive successful product launches.
 



 ● Define product messaging and go\-to\-market strategies for impactful launches.
 



 ● Represent the product function with senior leadership and communicate progress, insights, and outcomes.
 



 ● Define and monitor business KPIs to drive growth, revenue, and profitability.
 



 ● Identify new market opportunities and continuously refine product strategies for growth.
 



  





**Role Details:** 




**Experience:** 
 5–8 years
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday–Friday
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
 



  





**Why Nutrabay?** 




 At Nutrabay, we believe in an
 **open and intellectually honest culture** 
 where people have the autonomy to contribute, experiment, learn, and do their best work. You’ll have the opportunity to solve challenging problems, build new capabilities, work closely with cross\-functional teams, and develop skills that are valuable across roles and functions. We value
 **ownership, transparency, respect, and continuous learning** 
 , and believe that great work happens when people are trusted to make an impact.
 



  





**About Nutrabay** 




 Nutrabay is one of India’s leading
 **health \& nutrition eCommerce platforms** 
 , serving over
 **1 million customers** 
 to date. We have built a complex, high\-converting eCommerce ecosystem, with monthly traffic of
 **1M\+** 
 , and are continuously investing in our technology and product capabilities to fuel the next phase of growth. We are looking for a
 **visionary and agile Product Leader** 
 who can help shape the future of our eCommerce platform and build products that create meaningful customer and business impact.
 



  





**Funding** 




 Nutrabay has raised
 **$5 million in Series A funding** 
 , led by
 **RPSG Capital Ventures** 
 , with participation from
 **Kotak Alternate Asset Managers** 
 .

title: Sr Manager IT Product - Oracle Payroll
description:
**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for leading the strategy to deliver quality products across the digital experience (Mobile, Hotel Website, or Revenue Management). This role coordinates among business stakeholders, software developers, technical engineers, designers, data analysts, and other functional subject matter experts to create a comprehensive and holistic roadmap that address both short term and long\-term needs. They guide in\-depth business reviews, communicate and present across all levels of the organization and support cross\-functional product teams. The Group Product Manager will also prioritize and activate their roadmap, ultimately managing the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch to adoption to optimization in an agile methodology, pivoting as needed in response to stakeholder and customer needs. The Group Product Manager is skilled and experienced in generating innovative ideas for growth within their respective areas and must exhibit the ability to lead senior\-level Product Managers and/or leads teams of Product Managers that are responsible for higher\-profile, more impactful products.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Lead development and implementation of product strategy: future state based on deep understanding of how the business works, incorporating customer insights, markets, competition, and distribution capabilities as well as the potential “game changing” new functionality and capabilities IHG will require to compete. This should manifest itself in a roadmap of initiatives including small enhancement and content refreshments to existing products as well as new product needs.
   

  

 Identify product opportunities far in advance of obsolescence, drive strategic planning, and articulate topline business requirements
   

  

 Applies domain expertise to provide thought leadership and translate vision into action to drive business growth.
   

  

 Drives product development by reviewing performance and directing work efforts of product teams to ensure products are aligned with company, stakeholder and end\-user priorities
   

  

 Source data and craft test plans to ensure data\-driven decisioning; use insights to inform priority of work
   

  

 Proactively seek input from stakeholders to align the roadmap against business and customer needs
   

  

 Forecast ROI, regularly report on product performance post launch, drive product adoption, and lead the vision for the optimization plan
   

  

 Measure product performance and lead performance improvement initiatives.  Identify and understand the performance drivers and set up ongoing diagnostics and monitoring capabilities once implemented.
   

  

 Provides guidance on design of products while balancing dependencies and integration with other products across the enterprise
   

  

 Manage product lifecycles:  continually evaluate product performance and key customer insights and ensure new product needs are identified far enough in advance to address needs before product obsolescence.
   

  

 Communicate product information: including product roadmap, specifications, value proposition, sales tools training tools and competitive information to stakeholders.  Provide status updates to PMO for regular reporting cycles.
   

  

 Makes suggestions to drive operational excellence, create internal customer satisfaction and meet operational metrics
   

  

 Provide regular updates to leaders and partners, sometimes catering the message depending on audience
   

  

 Provides leadership, mentoring and coaching to Product Managers
   

  

 Attracts, retains and develops top talent to build a world class Product Management Team
   

  

 Conducts annual and mid\-year reviews, reviewing individual development plans and providing performance feedback
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Key Skills \& Experiences**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, User Experience, Customer Experience, Statistics, Business, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work\-related experienced.


**Experience**
* 6\-8 years of relevant work experience as a manager or Sr Product Manager in a modern software development company


**Skills \& Technical Experience**
* Expert knowledge of the IHG digital landscape as well as strong familiarity with competitors and other eCommerce websites to understand trends and best practices
* Mastery of working as a Product Manager in a modern software development\-based enterprise environment and overseeing multiple products
* Mastery of modern software development product management practices and agile methodologies, specifically the extreme programming (XP) principles of paired programming, test driven development and continuous deployment
* Mastery of working as part of a collaborative, cross\-functional, modern software design and development team
* Mastery of identifying goals, metrics and analytics to measure product value
* Able to recognize when and how to pivot with ease and effectively deliver.
* Demonstrated deep knowledge and understanding in a specific area of expertise including products.
* Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Demonstrated ability to present new concepts, research findings, and business outcomes to various groups including corporate clients, senior management, potential vendors, and industry consultants.
* Demonstrated program management experience with modern, established product management processes in organizing, planning and executing projects from conception through implementation. Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks/clients required.
* Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Demonstrated ability to adapt tactics and strategies to fast moving, rapidly evolving marketplace required
* Experience in formal requirements methodologies such as vision, scope, context, use cases, etc.
* Balances Stakeholders: Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders
* Drives Engagement: Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives
* Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals


**Preferred**
* Demonstrated hotel industry knowledge reflecting the entire customer experience journey (reservations – stay – loyalty – on\-property, and ongoing relationship management).
* Familiarity with AEM 6\.5 Touch UI a plus
* Interpersonal Savvy: Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people
* Manages Complexity: Making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems
* Organizational Savvy: Maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process, and people\-related organizational dynamics

You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.
   

  

 Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests \& owners love.
   

  

 We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
   

  

 We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.
   

  

 Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. title: Group Product Manager (Supply Chain/Operations)
description:
**Job Description: Group Product Manager – Supply Chain \& Operations** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 6 – 9 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 B2C E\-commerce / D2C / Logistics Tech / Quick Commerce
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Group Product Manager – Supply Chain \& Operations** 
 to own and lead the digital systems powering our end\-to\-end fulfillment, warehousing, and logistics network. In this role, you will lead a team of Product Managers and partner directly with Operations, Engineering, and Business leadership to build scalable backend technology that drives operational excellence, optimizes unit economics, and accelerates order\-to\-delivery cycles.
 



 Unlike consumer\-facing growth roles, this position is deeply anchored in internal platform architecture, operational workflows, inventory intelligence, and supply chain automation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Product Strategy \& Roadmap
 


* Define the long\-term product vision, strategy, and execution roadmap for the Supply Chain \& Operations Tech stack (Order Management Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, Inventory Intelligence, Dispatch \& Delivery).
* Identify operational bottlenecks and convert complex ground\-level logistics challenges into scalable software solutions.



 2\. Team Leadership \& Mentorship
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of Product Managers owning individual sub\-domains within supply chain and fulfillment.
* Establish product management best practices, key metrics frameworks, and operational governance across your team.



 3\. Core Platform Ownership
 


* **Order Management System (OMS):** 
 Build and scale order routing engines, split\-shipment logic, and order state machines.
* **Warehouse Management System (WMS):** 
 Optimize inbound receiving, putaway, picking, packing, staging, and inventory auditing workflows to drive warehouse throughput.
* **Inventory \& Procurement:** 
 Build real\-time inventory visibility systems, multi\-location stock replenishment algorithms, and vendor integration management.
* **Logistics \& Dispatch:** 
 Develop routing algorithms, middle\-mile/last\-mile dispatch engines, courier allocation logic, and real\-time tracking platforms.



 4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Execution
 


* Work closely with Ground Operations, Warehouse Managers, Logistics Partners, and Category teams to build intuitive internal tools.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams on system architecture, database scalability, and optimization models (e.g., route optimization, demand forecasting).



 Key Operational Metrics You Will Own
 


* **Fulfillment Speed \& SLA:** 
 Order processing time, dispatch SLA, and on\-time delivery (OTD) rates.
* **Warehouse Efficiency:** 
 Pick/pack speed, dock\-to\-stock duration, and labor productivity per warehouse.
* **Inventory Precision:** 
 Stock accuracy, shrinkage reduction, and wastage/spoilage rates.
* **Cost Efficiency:** 
 Shipping cost per order, warehouse operational cost per unit, and route density optimization.



**What We're Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 6–9 years overall experience with at least 4\+ years dedicated to building Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehousing, or Operations software in high\-scale e\-commerce, D2C, or 3PL environments.
* **Leadership:** 
 Prior experience managing and mentoring Product Managers or Associate PMs.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Deep hands\-on knowledge of WMS, OMS, TMS (Transportation Management Systems), inventory algorithms, and third\-party logistics (3PL) API integrations.
* **Technical Depth:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. degree or strong technical background required; ability to read API docs, evaluate system architecture, and collaborate effectively with senior engineering leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Problem Solver:** 
 Strong quantitative and analytical skills; fluent in SQL and telemetry/tracking tools to evaluate operational metrics.



**Preferred Background** 



* Product leaders from high\-scale B2C e\-commerce, D2C, quick commerce, retail\-tech, or third\-party logistics (3PL) platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with automated warehousing equipment, IoT integration, or AI/ML\-driven demand forecasting/routing platforms.

description:

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
   

  

 For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**Job Description**
**Head of Software, Enterprise Solutions**
 This role leads a strategically important segment of S\&P Global Market Intelligence’s Enterprise Solutions Software business, spanning Corporate Actions, Tax Solutions, and Cappitech. The portfolio combines managed data services and enterprise technology platforms that help capital markets firms reduce risk, improve compliance, and streamline complex post\-trade, asset servicing, tax, and regulatory reporting workflows.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Software business operates in a global, highly collaborative environment, partnering across Product, Sales, Customer Experience, Operations, and Technology to shape growth strategy, go\-to\-market execution, and revenue expansion across the portfolio. Our primary locations are in the US(NY), UK (London), and India (Gurgaon) with global sales coverage.

 The Head of Software will define and execute the commercial and product strategy for the full product suite, including growth, market positioning, pricing, client engagement, and strategic investment priorities. The role acts as an enterprise leader for the portfolio, connecting market needs, client value, product direction/investment, and commercial outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring deep expertise across asset servicing, post\-trade ecosystems, tax processing, and regulatory reporting, with the ability to identify market opportunities, influence product roadmap, and build trusted relationships with clients, partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders.
   

  

 A key focus will be leveraging AI to strengthen trusted decision\-making, governance, workflow integration, and operational resilience across the investment lifecycle.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and articulate a compelling market narrative.

**About S\&P Global Market Intelligence**
 At S\&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S\&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information.  For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence.
   

  

**What’s In It For**

title: Decision Analyst
description:
Join us as a Decision Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 The Decision Intelligence team at Barclays drives strategic business impact by applying advanced analytics and data science to solve complex challenges. Focused on enhancing profitability, customer experience, and operational efficiency, the team builds analytical capabilities to inform business strategies and case development. By uncovering growth opportunities, optimizing customer and digital strategies, and improving risk management, they deliver data\-driven and decision focused solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, fostering a culture of informed decision making and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
   

  

 To be a successful Decision Analyst, you should have experience in:
   

  

  

* Synthesizing business knowledge, market research, and analytics to drive strategic outcomes.
* Understanding value drivers across products and services, linking customer, operational, and financial levers.
* Breaking down complex challenges using frameworks such as MECE, hypothesis\-driven approaches, 5 WHYs, 80/20, and decision trees.
* Using Python, SQL, Excel, and Tableau to transform data into actionable insights.
* Generating insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Crafting compelling, data\-backed narratives for senior stakeholders and delivering powerful executive presentations.
* Coordinating cross\-functional teams and tracking benefits realization.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong communication and storytelling.
* Good at problem solving skills and strategic thinking.
* People leadership potential and guiding/coaching less experienced colleagues.
* AI Awareness/Adoption.


 You may be assessed on essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.
* Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.
* Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.
* Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision\-making across different business areas.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:** 
 Revenue Management
   

  

**Level:** 
 Deputy Manager /Manager
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Associate Director \- Revenue Management
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
   

  

**About The Function**
 Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.
   

  

 The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.
   

  

 This is further complemented by a world\-class post\-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self\-help features or our hand\-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry\-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.
   

  

 At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip\-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an independent, self\-starting, quick\-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross\-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high\-quality work under pressure.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
**P\&L and Revenue Management**
* Own and manage the business P\&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.


**Growth Strategy Development**
* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short\- and long\-term growth strategies, influencing key cross\-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.


**Customer Engagement \& Marketing Collaboration**
* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.


**Collaboration with Product \& Operations Stakeholders**
* Partner with product teams to develop first\-class, customer\-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business—preferably in the e\-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high\-growth, data\-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.

GeM covers the entire gamut of procurement process, right from vendor registration and item selection by buyers to receipt of goods and facilitation of timely payments. GeM has envisioned to utilise the agility and speed that come alongwith a digital platform createdwith a strategic intent to reinvigorate public procurement systems and bring about a lasting change for the underserved as well as the nation.

 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.

* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.
