title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.

title: Director, Strategy
description:
**VaynerX**
 VaynerX is a family of companies building brands for the now. Founded by Chairman Gary Vaynerchuk in January 2017, the modern\-day parent company is home to relevance\-driving businesses including VaynerMedia, ChukMedia, Tamara Group, Gallery Media Group, Eva Nosidam Productions, Tingley Lane Trading, and VaynerSpeakers.
   

  

**About Vaynermedia**
 VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies
 **.
   

  

 Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it.** 
 VaynerMedia APAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE.
   

  

 We’re looking for amazing people to join our team (more specifically, a
 **STRATEGY DIRECTOR** 
 ). The role is based in India
   

  

**Here’s where you come in...**
 You are a problem solver at heart and insanely curious about people, culture and technology. Most of all, you like to get your hands dirty, are obsessed with researching \& finding interesting things that are hidden from sight (even in the seemingly most mundane of places) and adept at translating your findings into compelling creative briefs, enjoy partnering with teams to see your work through from research to execution, and communicate your work with passion and conviction.
   

  

**What You Should Know About Our Team...**
 We’re collaborative and come from diverse backgrounds. We value creativity in research, and an outside\-in perspective when it comes to inspiration, strategic frameworks and problem\-solving. Technology has fundamentally changed the way we interact with others and the world around us, and we geek out about understanding behaviors in context, instead of probing humans in a petri dish.
   

  

**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia...**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

**Overall** 
**Purpose**
 Strategy at VaynerMedia provides a crucial perspective on the business dynamics. We are a human centric, culture obsessed discipline where we dive deep into audience insights, media trends, cultural shifts, and tech innovations that inform our strategic recommendations. Our team is collectively redefining and modernizing the way our clients harness consumer and cultural intelligence, develop brand strategy and plan for attention.
   

  

**KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY**
* Identify data\-driven insights in a logical flow in order to deliver a compelling and enlightening story to client.
* Bring the consumer’s world to life through the use of qualitative and cultural mining, plus insightful synthesis of quantitative research.
* Demonstrate analytical and strategic skills to help solve client’s business problems.
* Stay abreast of the competitive landscape as it pertains to data, human centered research, and scalable qualitative insights delivering meaningful results for our clients.
* Define/identify new methodologies for cultural analysis and development of cultural anthropology products that unlock VaynerMedia’s ability to ‘culture hack’ at speed and transform our clients’ businesses.
* Evaluate creative concepts and communication opportunities and provide sound feedback and/or recommendations, as appropriate.
* Facilitating brainstorms, workshops and ideation sessions that drive greater creativity and innovation.
* Direct the strategic development of client presentations and other important communication; delivering clear, compelling and persuasive communications to all stakeholders.
* Brief creative teams for ideation and help facilitate brainstorms and workshops.


**Desired Skills \& Experience:**
* 7\+ years experience building integrated programs at a top agency working for Fortune 500 clients \-\- must have experience understanding the intersection of business strategy, consumer insights, and digital behavior and developing big, purposeful ideas.
* Bilingual fluent proficiency in English and Hindi is a must as the social, media, and campaign advertising strategy has to be in Hindi to service the local target market.
* Experience doing traditional, web, social, syndicated and primary research (incl.: NetBase, MRI, Sysomos, Brandwatch, eMarketer, Mintel, Google Analytics, Omniture; conducting IDIs, digital ethnographies, etc.)
* Dazzling presentation skills and presence in a room
* Ability to express complicated concepts in simple and digestible ways (“Explain it to a fifth grader”)
* Curious and lovely to get along with


 You would be leading a team of talented strategists, social listening analysts, and community experts. As such, there are many hats you’d have to wear from day 1\. You would need to conduct research, write briefs, guide work, pitch to clients \- really anything and everything it takes to get the job done and deliver fantastic, big, bold, beautiful work.
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

**Company Description** 
 Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS), established by the Ministry of Railways in 1986, is the premier IT organization supporting the digital needs of Indian Railways. Headquartered in New Delhi with regional offices in major metro cities, CRIS designs and operates information systems for passenger ticketing, freight operations, train control, asset management, and other core railway functions across India, including remote and challenging locations. Its workforce of around 800 professionals combines advanced IT expertise with deep railway domain knowledge, enabling CRIS to deliver robust, cost\-effective solutions for complex operational needs. CRIS actively adopts cutting\-edge technologies such as mobile ticketing, GPS\-based train tracking, RFID\-based asset tracking, and geo\-spatial databases, and is building a state\-of\-the\-art data center for railway IT systems. The organization continues to expand into emerging areas including asset protection, energy management, overhead electrification, parcel management, employee health, and comprehensive financial management.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner at CRIS is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi, India, responsible for strategic oversight and direction of key information systems initiatives for Indian Railways. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining product and project vision, prioritizing technology roadmaps, and aligning IT solutions with operational and regulatory needs of the railway sector. The role involves collaborating with technical teams, railway domain experts, and government stakeholders to ensure that systems are scalable, secure, and cost\-effective. The Owner reviews project progress, manages risks, and makes decisions on resource allocation, timelines, and quality standards. This position also requires guiding innovation, ensuring adherence to governance and compliance frameworks, and representing CRIS in high\-level discussions related to digital transformation of Indian Railways.

* Strong leadership and ownership skills, including experience in driving complex IT or infrastructure programs from concept to implementation.

title: General Manager - Business
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.
 **We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.** 




 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows.
 **To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!** 




  





**Our Founding Team** 




  





 • Arun Bagaria – Co\-founder, Product — Ex\-Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory \| IIM Bangalore
 



 • Chirag Agrawal – Co\-founder, Business — Ex\-OYO, TravelTriangle \| IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
 



 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi
 



  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 
 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big,** 
 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 
 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 
 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 
 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



  





**Our philosophy is simple :** 
 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.
 



  





**Your Mission** 




  





 Own and scale a high\-growth business unit at TravClan with end\-to\-end accountability for strategy, revenue, contribution margin, customer outcomes and execution. Build the growth engine, team and operating systems required to deliver ambitious and sustainable business results
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  





 1\. Own the strategy and P\&L of the assigned business unit, including GMV, revenue, contribution margin, customer growth and operating costs.
 



 2\. Build and execute sales and go\-to\-market plans across acquisition, activation, retention and account expansion.
 



 3\. Identify and scale new customer segments, products, channels and partnerships based on customer insight and market opportunity.
 



 4\. Lead strategic customer and partner relationships and negotiate terms that improve margins, service quality or market access.
 



 5\. Build and lead a high\-performing team with clear goals, KPIs, decision rights and leadership depth. Run a rigorous operating cadence using data on pipeline, conversion, productivity, unit economics and customer outcomes.
 



 6\. Partner across Product, Marketing, Operations, Supply, Finance and Analytics to remove bottlenecks and deliver the business plan.
 



  





**What is on Offer ?** 



* Ownership of a meaningful business charter with direct founder access.
* The opportunity to build teams, systems and partnerships at scale.
* Competitive compensation of about 35\-50 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)Long\-term wealth creation through ESOPs



  





**Growth Path:** 



* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  





 • 5\+ years of experience with significant ownership of a P\&L, business unit, category or large revenue charter.
 



 • Evidence of growing revenue and margins, not merely maintaining operations.
 



 • Strong sales, go\-to\-market, commercial and analytical capability.
 



 • Experience building teams and developing managers or second\-line leaders.
 



 • Entrepreneurial judgement, high ownership and comfort operating through ambiguity.
 



 • Relevant experience in travel, marketplaces, consumer internet, fintech, SaaS or another high\-velocity business.
 



 • Candidates should be able to quantify the P\&L managed, revenue and margin growth delivered, team size led and one business initiative they personally built or materially scaled.
 



  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  





 • You enjoy carrying a business number and owning the complete outcome.
 



 • You can move between strategy, sales, data, people and execution.
 



 • You challenge the status quo and solve root causes.
 



  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  





 • You prefer advisory roles without direct revenue and execution ownership.
 



 • You are uncomfortable with ambitious targets or difficult commercial decisions.
 



 • You prefer narrowly defined responsibilities and established playbooks.
 



 • You avoid using data to diagnose performance and hold teams accountable.
 



  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  





**1\. Personal Interviews:** 
 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 



**2\. Extending an offer** 
 : On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 



  





**Important Points** 




  





**Location** 
 : Connaught Place, New Delhi
 



 Work Schedule:
 **You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: Associate Director- New Delhi
description:
****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).
   

  

****About The Position****
 The Associate Director provides strategic, technical and operational leadership for Jhpiego India's Cancer, control portfolio. The position is responsible for shaping the overall program strategy, developing new business opportunities, ensuring high\-quality implementation across multiple states, strengthening partnerships with governments and donors, managing large multidisciplinary teams, and driving innovation and evidence generation.
   

  

 The position will play a critical role in positioning Jhpiego as a national leader in comprehensive Cancer control and NCD programming by integrating service delivery innovations, digital technologies, implementation science, health financing approaches and public\-private partnerships.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
**Strategic and Technical Leadership**
* Provide strategic vision and technical leadership for Jhpiego's Cancer and NCD portfolio across India.
* Develop long\-term strategic plans aligned with national priorities and global commitments on cancer care continuum and NCD control.
* Provide strategic guidance on implementation of WHO and Government of India guidelines for cancer screening and NCD management.
* Lead the design of innovative service delivery models across prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment, survivorship and palliative care.
* Support development of national and state operational guidelines, SOPs, training packages and quality standards.
* Promote integration of digital health, AI\-enabled diagnostics, telemedicine and innovative technologies into program implementation.
* Identify emerging opportunities and position Jhpiego as a preferred technical partner for governments and development agencies.
* Provide strategic oversight for integration of common cancers into Comprehensive Primary Health Care platform.


**Program Management, Budgets, and Donor Compliance**
* Manages program work plans, budgets, and donor deliverables, ensuring compliance with philanthropic and institutional requirements.
* Oversees risk management and ensures timely, high\-quality delivery against agreed milestones.
* Provide oversight of multiple national and state\-level projects within the Cancer and NCD portfolio.
* Ensure timely achievement of project deliverables, quality standards, donor compliance and contractual obligations.
* Lead annual work planning, budgeting, forecasting and financial monitoring.
* Oversee program risk management and ensure effective mitigation strategies.
* Monitor portfolio performance through data\-driven decision making and adaptive management.


**Government and Partnership Engagement**
* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Health Mission and State Governments
* Engage with national technical institutions, professional societies, academic organizations and regulatory bodies.
* Representing Jhpiego in national technical working groups, policy forums and advisory committees.

* Develop strategic partnerships with multilateral agencies, bilateral donors and philanthropic organizations.


**Team Leadership, Capacity Development, and Evidence Generation**

* Support recruitment, performance management and professional development.
* Stewards the evidence\-generation agenda, including analytical notes, research engagement, and the use of evidence to inform program direction.


****Knowledge, Skills And Competencies****
* Strong technical knowledge of cancer prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment pathways and survivorship.

title: Co-Founder(Investment Based)
description:
**Company Description** 




 Natvora is a health\-focused food brand dedicated to delivering products in their purest form—raw, natural, and free from chemicals or preservatives. The company specializes in clean\-label, nutrient\-rich offerings that avoid artificial processing and unnecessary additives. Natvora’s philosophy is rooted in serving food exactly as nature intended, with nothing added and nothing taken away. Applicants joining Natvora will be part of a mission\-driven team committed to transparency, authenticity, and better everyday nutrition for consumers.
 



**Role Description** 




 As a Co\-Founder (Investment Based) at Natvora, you will take a leading role in shaping the company’s strategy, growth, and market positioning while contributing capital to support expansion. This is a full\-time on\-site role based in New Delhi, where you will collaborate closely with existing founders on business planning, product roadmap, and operational decision\-making. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include evaluating market opportunities, overseeing sales and marketing initiatives, guiding brand and customer acquisition strategies, and monitoring key performance metrics. You will engage in partnership development, investor and stakeholder communication, and support fundraising and financial planning activities. The role involves hands\-on involvement in building teams, refining processes, and ensuring that Natvora’s core values of purity, health, and sustainability are reflected in every aspect of the business.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong analytical skills for market assessment, financial evaluation, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills for stakeholder engagement, team collaboration, and clear brand messaging.
* Proven sales skills for driving revenue growth, managing customer relationships, and supporting distribution strategies.
* Demonstrated marketing skills for brand building, digital and offline campaigns, and growth\-focused initiatives.
* Solid research skills to explore consumer trends, competitive landscapes, and product innovation opportunities.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with prior experience in building or scaling a business, preferably in FMCG, food, or health and wellness sectors.
* Ability to take ownership, work in a fast\-paced environment, and make informed decisions under uncertainty.
* Financial acumen and readiness to participate as an investment\-based co\-founder, with a long\-term commitment to the company’s vision.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field is preferred.

title: Product Manager II

 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**About The Role**

This role demands someone who thrives in ambiguity, earns stakeholder trust at all levels, and holds a high bar for execution and outcomes.

 Strategic Product Leadership

 Execution Excellence \& Platform Health
   

  

* Drive delivery accountability: sprint hygiene, backlog depth health, SLI/SLO monitoring, and prod bug leakage.

 Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain—own escalation paths and surface deviations with a remedy.
* Lead alignment across Sales, CS, Engineering, UX, and Leadership; build trust at all levels of the org.
* Partner with integration vendors and enterprise customers to gather requirements and translate them into actionable product specs.
* Present roadmap progress and risks clearly to leadership


**Here's What You Need**
* 9–12 years of experience with 5\+ years in product management for SaaS products.
* Hands\-on experience building AI products is a strong plus; proficiency with AI tools is required.
* Proficiency with analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Gainsight PX, Pendo, or similar) to measure and drive adoption.
* Experience with third\-party integrations and enterprise software ecosystems is a plus.
* Strong product sense: can articulate problems clearly, write specs that start with "the why," and envision solutions at scale.
* Solid grasp of software development, integrations, and system design—able to go deep with engineering partners.
* Data\-driven, analytical, and a self\-starter who can take ownership from concept through completion.
* Exceptional communicator and influencer—comfortable navigating ambiguity and building alignment across all levels.

title: Digital Product Manager - Web Author

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 As a web author, digital product, you will focus on providing content management system (CMS) authoring, design, and capabilities support for enterprise digital marketing projects across multiple business units. To be successful, you must have experience with CMS platforms, strong design skills, and the ability to manage digital content to support marketing initiatives. This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with other web authors, product managers, product owners, content developers and colleagues on cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). * Knowledge of web and mobile technologies and experience with digital marketing tools

**Senior Product Manager, Loyalty**
**Team Description**
 The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on assurance products strategy for members across Hotels.com, Vrbo, and BEX. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia \& Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML\-driven personalization, promotions \& incentives etc.

* A prioritized roadmap that balances member value, commercial outcomes, and delivery feasibility.

* Proven track record of building and scaling products with multiple stakeholders and business constraints.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and business stakeholders.

title: Product Manager
description:
We are seeking a data\-driven and execution\-focused Product Manager (4–5 years of
 



 experience) to own and scale our core payment infrastructure. In this role, you will be
 



 responsible for building seamless checkout experiences, integrating payment gateways (PGs),
 



 optimizing transaction routing, and leading consumer/merchant payment flows across UPI,
 



 cards, netbanking, mandates and alternative payment methods.
 



 You will act as the bridge between engineering, design, risk, compliance, and partner
 



 banks/aggregators to drive higher transaction success rates, reduce checkout friction, and
 



 maintain strict adherence to regulatory standards (NPCI/RBI).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Checkout \& PG Integrations: Own the end\-to\-end checkout funnel. Design, integrate, and optimize payment gateways, aggregators, routing engines, and tokenization solutions to lower latency and increase Payment Success Rates (PSR).
 



 • Payment journeys: product initiatives across payment stacks: UPI(Intent, Collect, QR, AutoPay, Credit on UPI), Cards – Debit \& credit, Netbanking, Wallets and BNPL
 



 • Product Discovery \& Execution: Define the payment strategy, prioritize the product backlog, and write clear, engineering\-ready PRDs with explicit technical acceptance criteria and edge\-case handling logic.
 



 • Conversion Optimization \& Funnel Analysis: Use analytical tools (SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude) to identify drop\-off points, design A/B tests, and optimize payment recovery flows (e.g., auto\-retry mechanisms, dynamic fallback options).
 



 • Reconciliation \& Settlement Operations: Collaborate with finance and operations to build reliable automated reconciliation, refund, payout, and chargeback/dispute resolution workflows.
 



 • Regulatory Compliance \& Security: Maintain strict compliance with RBI, NPCI, PCI\-DSS guidelines, and PA/PG regulatory frameworks from initial spec to production rollout.
 



 • Cross\-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Risk \& Fraud, Legal, and Bank/Partner Integration teams to deliver features on schedule.
 



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 




 • Experience: 4–5 years of hands\-on Product Management experience within Fintech,
 



 Digital Payments, or E\-commerce.
 



 • Domain Mastery: Proven experience with PG/PA integrations, checkout funnel
 



 optimization, UPI infrastructure (P2P/P2M, AutoPay)
 



 • Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to read API documentation, map sequence diagrams, understand webhook architectures, and collaborate closely with backend/infrastructure engineers.
 



 • Data\-Driven Mindset: Hands\-on experience analyzing funnel metrics, building reports via SQL or BI tools, and conducting hypothesis\-driven experimentation.
 



 • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem, including NPCI circulars, RBI payment guidelines, and tokenization mandates.
 



 • Execution Excellence: Track record of taking complex 0\-to\-1 or 1\-to\-10 payment products from concept to launch in fast\-paced environments.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Experience with merchant onboarding/activation flows or developer\-facing APIs/SDKs.
 



 • Hands\-on familiarity with fraud mitigation tools, risk engines, or AI\-assisted product development workflows.

title: Nykaa - Product Manager II
description:
**Role : Product Manager II \| Nykaa Fashion**
**Location :** 
 Gurgaon \|
 **Experience :** 
 2 \- 4 years \|
 **Team :** 
 Product \- Nykaa Fashion
   

  

 Fashion meets Product. And we're looking for someone who gets both.
   

  

 Nykaa Fashion is building the next generation of fashion shopping experiences \- experiences that are more visual, inspiring, social and AI\-native.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager II to work on some of our newest bets : ideas that may start with a customer insight, prototype or experiment and have the potential to become entirely new experiences for millions of shoppers.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap and optimize it by 2%.
   

  

 You'll find problems worth solving, build from zero, experiment quickly and scale what works.
   

  

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
**Insights Analyst** 




**A US\-headquartered product company scaling its India insights team** 




**Location:** 
 Delhi, India — hybrid
 



**The Gap This Role Closes** 




 A US\-headquartered product company is scaling its India insights team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an analyst who can do more than produce reports — someone who reads a pile of usage data, survey responses, and market research and comes back with an actual point of view on what the business should do next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



 The company already has data. What it is short of is someone willing to commit to a recommendation instead of handing back a chart and letting the room decide.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Pull together product usage data, customer research, and competitive signals into a single, coherent view of what is happening and why
* Turn ambiguous questions from product and leadership into a research plan, and the research plan into a specific recommendation
* Present findings to stakeholders who will push back, and defend the recommendation on its merits, not just the data behind it



**How You'll Operate** 



* Partner with product, marketing, and strategy teams to understand what decision an analysis needs to unblock before you start it
* Build repeatable frameworks for the questions that come up quarter after quarter, instead of starting from zero each time
* Flag when the data does not support a clean answer, rather than forcing one



**What You Bring** 




 2 to 6 years in research, analytics, insights, or strategy, with a track record of turning data into a recommendation someone acted on — not just a deck someone read. Strong analytical instincts, comfort with ambiguity, and the writing skill to make a complex finding land in three sentences. Working knowledge of SQL, Excel or Sheets, and at least one BI tool.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a product or SaaS company specifically, rather than pure market\-research or academic research
* Exposure to Python or R for deeper analysis
* A background in consulting, strategy, or a similarly recommendation\-driven role



**What You'll Gain** 



* A seat where your output is a decision, not a dashboard nobody reopens
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct visibility into how product and leadership actually use research



**How We Hire** 




 HR Screening → Case Study Assignment → Team Round → Culture Fit
 



 One application is considered for this role and any future matched openings, so there is no need to apply twice.

title: Engineering Manager (Passkeys)
description:
**Engineering Manager, Passkeys**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
